articles.title: Escolas que bloquearem IA poderão perder acesso à busca do Google
articles.summary:
Alunos que utilizam as ferramentas educacionais do Google poderão perder acesso ao mecanismo de busca se suas escolas não aceitarem recursos de inteligência artificial (IA) integrados às pesquisas. Anunciada na terça-feira (3), a nova política provocou críticas de educadores, políticos e especialistas.
As instituições poderão controlar os serviços individualmente, mas terão de aceitar algum recurso de IA na busca para continuar oferecendo o Google Search. A implementação está prevista para o início de 2027.
Escolas terão controle sobre ferramentas, mas com uma condição
A decisão ocorre após meses de resistência ao Gemini nas salas de aula. Até agosto, o Google só permitia habilitar o chatbot para estudantes com 18 anos ou mais. Naquele mês, anunciou sua disponibilização para alunos mais novos em redes que autorizassem ferramentas de IA.
Agora, os administradores poderão escolher quais serviços estarão disponíveis, incluindo Gemini, Gemini Notebook e Google Search. Todos ficarão desativados por padrão até que as instituições autorizem seu uso.
As escolas poderão manter o Gemini desativado, mas precisarão aceitar algum recurso de IA incorporado às pesquisas para liberar o buscador. Chris Phillips, vice-presidente e gerente-geral de educação do Google, explicou ao The New York Times que os serviços estão profundamente conectados. Sem essa autorização, os estudantes receberão uma mensagem de indisponibilidade.

See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents
Personal agents are the intermediary between humans and the Internet, turning a person’s instructions into requests and actions on websites. A customer might ask a personal agent to compare products across your site, find support articles, or complete a purchase. To a site owner, all three interactions show up as automated traffic — and without a clear view of which agents are visiting and what they are doing, it can be difficult to know whether that traffic is helping your business or creating risk. Blocking agents altogether can feel like the safest choice, but it can mean losing customers. Better visibility into agent activity allows you to decide what access makes sense for your site.
Today, we’re launching new analytics to help you understand how personal agents access your site on behalf of humans, along with more granular access policies to put those decisions into practice. Together, they let you welcome agents on your own terms, and in ways that support your business.
See how agents access your site

Artificial Intelligence
How U Mobile built agentic telco operations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
U Mobile, Malaysia’s newest 5G network provider, has always run its telco operations lean, doing more with less through continuous automation. When new AI capabilities became available, U Mobile explored how to enhance operational efficiency beyond basic productivity gains. The real opportunity was further upstream, in how operations teams diagnose and resolve problems in the first place. The same lean operating discipline shaped the foundation for AiDaH: not a one-off technology initiative, but the next step in a long-running journey to simplify operations and scale capability without adding complexity.
When a subscriber can’t purchase a data add-on, resolving it isn’t a single problem. It’s a coordination problem. A customer service agent needs to pull interface logs for error codes. The same agent must then query business support system APIs for subscriber eligibility, and cross-reference internal knowledge bases for applicable business policies. All of that happens across multiple systems, before drafting a single word of response. And when that fails, the ticket escalates to backend IT teams and the subscriber waits even longer.
Traditional automation tools can help agents write better responses. What they can’t do is navigate multiple systems, analyze the results, and propose corrective action. Closing that gap takes an agentic architecture built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore…

articles.title: Meta Shares Top Muse Bug Bounty Findings as Payouts Reach $1.2 Million
articles.summary:
Meta has paid roughly $1.2 million in bug bounties for its Muse AI agent, including $300,000 for a pre-launch flaw that exposed data on internal test systems.
Muse is a personal AI agent that acts on a user’s behalf across their email, calendar, messaging and other accounts. Each user’s agent gets its own virtual machine.
The bug bounty program ran privately from April and went public at the agent’s September 8 launch, Meta’s David Singleton said in a blog post. Of the more than 630 reports received, 64 were valid.
The $300,000 reward was handed out four months before launch, while Muse was at an early internal testing stage. The researcher demonstrated access to conversations and tokens on pre-release VMs used by Meta staff to test the product.
“An authentication check treated a header added by a local HTTPS proxy as proof that a request came from a trusted source. During a system migration, the environment gained a second proxy layer. That meant requests from outside could carry the trusted header too,” Singleton explained.
Meta took the service offline, fixed the bug and stopped treating the local machine as trusted.
A $90,000 bounty was paid for a report involving a malicious web page that, when Muse was asked to summarize it, mimicked status messages from the agent’s browsing tool. “It got the agent to execute some actions which should have been caught,” Singleton noted.
Meta has since added detection signals and changed how Muse treats tool output that looks suspicious.…

articles.title: Test de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, et c'est toujours 10 sur 10
articles.summary:
Lorsque Nintendo a officialisé ce que certains créateurs de contenu en manque de buzz ont pris bien trop de plaisir à faire fuiter, l’industrie du jeu vidéo a quelque peu tremblé. Après tant d’années à fantasmer sur une version modernisée de celui que beaucoup considéraient toujours comme le plus grand chef-d’œuvre de tous les temps, le retour de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sous forme d’un remake exclusif à la Nintendo Switch 2 est devenu une improbable réalité. Mais à l’heure des possibilités infinies d’une IA que personne ne maîtrise vraiment, cette firme si traditionnaliste était-elle capable d’offrir aux joueurs une expérience à la hauteur de ce que des années de projets de fans sous Unreal Engine nous ont fait espérer ? N’ayons pas peur des mots : Nintendo a fait opérer sa magie une fois de plus, dans des proportions que nous n’imaginions pas, et dont nous n’osions même pas rêver.
Points forts
- Un game design d’ensemble qui n’a finalement pas vraiment vieilli
- Les cinématiques et réorchestrations musicales sont formidables
- Ce sentiment unique de revivre un des plus grands chef-d’œuvre de tous les temps avec des moyens modernes
Points faibles
- Pas de mode difficile ni de Master Quest à débloquer
- Le choix de bouton pour courir n’est pas ergonomique du tout
- Vous voyez à quel point on en vient à inventer des défauts ?
Un remake foncièrement indispensable
Est-il vraiment nécessaire de vous faire l’affront de réexpliquer ce qu’est vraiment The Legend of Zelda…

articles.title: La "zona cero" de la demografía en Europa: entre Ourense y Zamora la fertilidad está por debajo de 1 hijo por mujer
articles.summary:
¿Se está quedando España sin hijos? En ‘Hijos de los hombres’, la obra maestra de Alfonso Cuarón, la humanidad lleva 18 años sin un solo nacimiento y la historia transcurre en 2027. Faltan dos meses para ese vaticinio, y siguen naciendo niños, pero un mapa de Eurostat que ha circulado estos días en redes explica por qué encaja dicha comparación: en 2024 16 regiones españolas bajaron de un hijo por mujer. ¿Causas? Decenas, pero la principal preocupación no es biológica.
Qué dicen los datos. La tasa de fertilidad de la UE fue de 1,34 hijos por mujer en 2024, la más baja desde 2001, y España cerró con 1,10, solo por encima de Malta. Dentro de España, las cuatro islas canarias tienen los valores más bajos de la UE, con La Palma en 0,76.
Si dejamos esto a un lado, Eurostat cita entre las siguientes a Ourense y Pontevedra, junto a regiones de Grecia e Italia. Los datos del INE para 2024 lo confirman: Ourense 0,88, Pontevedra 0,93, Asturias 0,95, León 0,95 y Zamora 0,96. Lugo, con 1,03, queda algo por encima. A Coruña rondaba el 1,01 en 2023. En Ourense nacen 4,15 niños por cada mil habitantes, frente a los 6,49 de la media nacional.
Qué significa un 0,88. El nivel de reemplazo está en torno a 2,10, sin hablar de inmigración. Ourense, con 0,88, está en menos de la mitad. Si esa cifra se mantuviera sin migración, cada generación de mujeres sería menos de la mitad que la anterior. A imagem mostra centenas de rastros luminosos cruzando o horizonte e chamou tanta atenção que algumas pessoas chegaram a acusar o autor de ter utilizado inteligência artificial (IA) para criá-la.
O responsável pelo registro é Brendan Larsen, astrofotógrafo de 51 anos que fotografou o céu sobre o monte Taranaki, na Nova Zelândia. Apesar das suspeitas, a imagem é resultado de um trabalho fotográfico real, que exigiu planejamento, centenas de registros e muitas horas de edição.
Larsen capturou 578 fotografias durante aproximadamente duas horas. Cada registro teve exposição de oito segundos. Posteriormente, ele reuniu as imagens em uma composição que levou cerca de 40 horas para ser finalizada no Photoshop.
O resultado é uma fotografia que reúne aproximadamente 1,4 mil satélites e 14 mil rastros luminosos, evidenciando a quantidade de objetos artificiais que atravessam o céu noturno.

Artificial Intelligence
Four layers of context engineering for production AI agents: How Deep Insight applies them in working code
When production AI agents handle tasks such as data analysis and report generation, context management can become a major bottleneck. A 200K-token window sounds generous until a real-world task burns through most of it in minutes. Data analysis and report generation leave the agent failing mid-execution, losing accuracy, or driving up costs. A body of published guidance already addresses this, but the individual techniques are easier to read about than to apply. Applied together, they make a measurable difference: in the reference implementation this post walks through, a single write-and-execute tool cuts the tokens each script adds to context by about 95 percent, and loading skills on demand shrinks the system prompt by about 97 percent.
This series organizes that guidance into practices you can apply directly. Anthropic’s engineering posts, together with features built into the Strands Agents SDK, converge on four layers of context engineering: isolate context at the architecture level, control it through prompts, externalize it to the filesystem, and verify it with independent agents and safeguards. Airtel Nigeria, the country’s second-largest network operator, now lets subscribers see nearby 4G and 5G network sites, including those undergoing upgrades and planned installations, through a new feature on the My Airtel Africa app.
The feature, called Airtel Open Network, also allows customers to report poor network experiences directly to the telecom operator. Launched in Lagos on October 30, 2026, the platform displays network sites within a 500-metre radius of a subscriber’s location. It uses visual indicators to distinguish active sites, those being upgraded, and locations where new sites are planned.
Nigeria is the first of Airtel Africa’s 14 operating markets to introduce the feature. By combining network visibility with customer feedback, Airtel hopes to identify coverage gaps and direct engineering attention to areas where subscribers experience poor connectivity.
The move tackles a persistent problem in Nigeria’s telecoms market: network coverage does not always translate to reliable connectivity. Airtel hopes greater network visibility and direct customer feedback will help identify coverage gaps and improve service quality.
A Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) assessment reported by TechCabal found that 78% of major roads had mobile signals, but only about 42% offered stable, high-speed 4G or 5G connectivity. articles.title: Ataque a sistemas de refrigeração coloca bancos de sangue em risco na Europa
articles.summary:
Hackers atacaram sistemas de refrigeração usados no armazenamento de plasma sanguíneo na França, entre 1º e 2 de novembro. A invasão alterou a programação de temperatura dos freezers, em mais um episódio de ataques contra equipamentos ligados a serviços essenciais.
O alvo foi a Coolworld, fornecedora do Estabelecimento Francês de Sangue (EFS). O caso ocorreu poucas semanas depois de ataques semelhantes a freezers de supermercados na Europa.
Ataque alterou temperatura de freezers de plasma
Segundo o site Cyberattaque, citado pelo Cyber Security News, os invasores programaram os equipamentos para elevar a temperatura de -30 °C para 110 °C. Não se sabe se os freezers chegaram efetivamente a esse nível.
O EFS é responsável pela coleta, preparação e distribuição de sangue e derivados na França, utilizados em cirurgias e outros procedimentos médicos. Entre os produtos potencialmente ameaçados estava o plasma congelado destinado a transfusões.
O Ministério da Saúde francês informou que o ataque não provocou consequências operacionais graves. As alterações de temperatura foram identificadas rapidamente e corrigidas. Ainda não foram divulgados o número de instalações atingidas, a duração da interrupção ou as temperaturas efetivamente alcançadas. Também não há confirmação de que algum estoque de sangue tenha precisado ser descartado.

ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
You can use ChatGPT to edit a GIF’s animation speed and individual frames.
Before this change, ChatGPT couldn’t natively generate GIFs in a single step. An example shared by the company shows how ChatGPT can generate a GIF in response to the prompt, “can you make a gif of a cat dancing?” while also providing you with the option to change the playback speed and view it frame by frame.
Along with support for GIF-making, the Images 2.6 update also enables faster image generation in ChatGPT, OpenAI says. The company says users now generate over 4 billion images per week across ChatGPT and its API, a jump from the 3 billion per week it reported in September.
Images 2.6 is rolling out to all ChatGPT and Codex users across web, desktop, and mobile apps. OpenAI is also launching GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst in its API for faster and higher-quality image generation.

articles.title: Chrome 157 Rolls Out With 213 Security Fixes, Seven Rated Critical
articles.summary:
Google has promoted Chrome 157 to the stable channel with patches for 213 vulnerabilities, including seven critical memory safety bugs.
At the top of the list is a buffer overflow issue in Dawn, the open source and cross-platform implementation of the WebGPU standard. It earned the reporting researcher a $10,000 reward.
The second is a memory corruption in the open source graphics engine abstraction layer ANGLE that was awarded a $1,000 bug bounty.
No rewards were listed for the remaining five critical flaws (four use-after-free defects and a buffer overflow). Google reported two of them, Anthropic’s Xinyang Ge reported two, and researcher Wenbin Liu reported the fifth.
Chrome 157 also fixes 77 high-severity vulnerabilities, including more than a dozen reported by external researchers. However, Google has disclosed only the bounties paid for two of them, namely $10,000 for an incorrect authorization, and $2,000 for an out-of-bounds read.
Per Google’s advisory, the company handed out $31,000 in rewards to the reporting researchers, but it has not determined the bug bounties to be paid for 39 of the flaws.
The most common types of vulnerabilities the fresh browser update resolves include incorrect/missing authorization (51), use-after-free (45), UI misrepresentation (19), type confusion (13), information leak (13), out-of-bounds read/write (11), improper input validation (9), and uninitialized resource (9).

articles.title: Fibre cuts threaten Nigeria's digital economy, who pays?
articles.summary:
When Nigeria’s president, Bola Tinubu, signed the Designation and Protection of Critical National Information Infrastructure (CNII) Order in June 2024, the Federal Government aimed to shield telecommunications assets from relentless vandalism and physical damage. By classifying fibre lines, base stations, and data centres as vital national security installations, the order sought to impose deterrent penalties and curb unauthorised tampering.
Yet two years on, chronic breaches continue to impose steep financial penalties on operators, diverting capital from network expansion to nonstop emergency repairs and destabilising internet reliability across the country.
In 2023, before the order, MTN Nigeria suffered more than 6,000 fibre cuts in a single year—averaging roughly 16-17 severed lines per day.
Fast-forward to 2025, past the presidential order: the numbers increased; between January and July, the telco recorded 5,478 fibre cuts. That pushed its daily average to over 26 snapped cables.
In plain terms, instead of scaring reckless diggers and vandals away and improving coordination between construction firms and other key stakeholders, the new rules led MTN Nigeria to fix about eight more broken cables per day than before the order was introduced.

articles.title: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters
How should security leaders preserve human oversight as AI agents take on more work? Permissions establish which actions agents can take, but a permitted action can still warrant a person’s judgment. Requiring approval for every step might seem like the safest approach, yet multi-step tasks can produce repeated prompts, even for routine actions. Research on security warnings shows that attention and adherence can decline with repetition. The challenge isn’t to require more approvals, but to preserve attention for decisions that need human review.
Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick addresses this challenge by reviewing eligible actions within your existing controls. It evaluates each proposed action against the user’s request and either approves it automatically or returns it to the user for review. It does this without granting additional permissions or removing required human approvals. Security leaders retain control over which actions must always go to a person, while Smart Approvals is designed to reduce unnecessary interruptions in routine work.
Policy sets the boundary
Quick evaluates each proposed action against Custom Permissions, Quick Guardrails, connector action permissions, and the user’s settings before automated review. articles.title: EEUU tuvo una idea hace 20 años para matar a los mosquitos. China la acaba de hacer realidad con una torreta láser automática para pulverizarlos

Hace casi dos décadas, un grupo de ingenieros estadounidenses tuvo una idea que parecía sacada de la ciencia ficción: construir un sistema capaz de identificar mosquitos en pleno vuelo y derribarlos con disparos láser. El proyecto llegó a funcionar, pero nunca se convirtió en un producto de consumo. Ahora, desde China han recuperado aquel concepto, le han añadido inteligencia artificial y están intentando llevarlo al mercado por unos 1.000 dólares.
El resultado parece un sistema de defensa antiaérea en miniatura.
La idea nació en Estados Unidos. En 2006, Nathan Myhrvold, antiguo director de tecnología de Microsoft y fundador de Intellectual Ventures, planteó a un grupo de ingenieros una pregunta insólita: ¿sería posible matar mosquitos con un láser? La propuesta surgió de conversaciones sobre cómo combatir la malaria, una enfermedad transmitida por mosquitos que seguía causando cientos de miles de muertes anuales.
Entre los especialistas involucrados estaba Lowell Wood, un físico que había trabajado en proyectos relacionados con la defensa estratégica estadounidense durante la Guerra Fría. Su respuesta fue diseñar una especie de barrera invisible que pudiera detectar insectos, distinguirlos de otros animales y dispararles automáticamente. La llamaron Photonic Fence, o valla fotónica, y en 2009 Intellectual Ventures ya había construido prototipos funcionales.

Apple will start checking iCloud items that are accessible to anyone who has the link for “harmful content” starting with iOS 27.3 and other 27.3 updates, the company says.
Apple will check shared iCloud links for ‘harmful content’
If you make an item on iCloud available to anyone who has the link, Apple will be able to check it starting with iOS 27.3.
“When you share an item that can be accessed by Anyone with the Link in version 27.3 or later of iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, that content is made accessible to Apple to check for harmful content,” according to a support document reported on by 9to5Mac. Sharing something over iCloud with the “Anyone with the Link” permissions will also mean that it’s no longer end-to-end encrypted.
Apple’s support document does not define what “harmful content” is. But this new approach follows calls from protestors for Apple to crack down on child sexual abuse material stored in iCloud.
Apple says it “reserves the right to move, refuse, modify, remove, or delete” any harmful content that a user attempts to upload. Apple may also block or disable accounts, prevent a user from making a new account, or, “if necessary,” invoke law enforcement.
The company launched the first 27.3 developer betas yesterday, and said recently it plans to launch iOS 27.3 in December.

Some of the questions you ask when evaluating an agent are narrow and repeatable. Did this response stay on policy? Is this tool call safe to approve? Does this answer match the retrieved context? articles.title: The Art and History of the Video Game Parry
articles.summary:
If you've ever played literally any game with combat in the last few years, chances are you already know what a parry is. It's that little window where instead of running or blocking like a total coward, you hit the exact right button at the exact right time and suddenly the fight flips in your favor. It feels amazing when you land it, and... absolutely brutal when you don't.
But this hasn't always been the case. I recently realized something very obvious: parrying wasn't always everywhere in gaming. Somewhere along the way, developers looked at combat and decided, "What if instead of just blocking, you could punish someone for attacking you?" That idea has taken all sorts of forms, from old-school fighting games to some of the biggest RPGs around.
Finding the first person to put it in a game is trickier. Does a well-timed sword block count? Does it need to stagger the attacker? What about batting away a projectile?
Depending on where you draw those lines, you get a different family tree. The interesting part is how those branches grew.
So Where Does the Word Parry Even Come From?
The word "parry" wasn't always a gaming word. It's borrowed from fencing, with roots in the French parer, meaning "to ward off." This makes sense once you think about it. Fencing is literally two people trying to land a hit on each other while also trying not to get hit themselves, and that's, well, a pretty good pitch for a video game.

articles.title: Hackers use n-day exploits in zero-click attacks on iOS, Android devices
articles.summary:
A large-scale watering hole attack associated with Russian hackers has been targeting iOS and Android users visiting compromised sites or fake ones impersonating legitimate portals.
The campaign used multiple high-profile websites in the U.S., Ukraine, the Czech Republic, and Bulgaria that delivered the same payload for profiling visitors and their devices.
This initial stage allows the attacker to determine the browser version to deploy "platform-specific n-day exploit chains without user interaction."
Researchers at cybersecurity company Sekoia attribute the operation with moderate-to-high confidence to APT29 (aka Midnight Blizzard), a Russian threat group that was recently linked to hotel WiFi attacks.
Based on their findings, compromised legitimate sites belong to a Ukrainian gas producer, a U.S. chemical industry trade association, and a Bulgarian military-related site.
Lookalike domains impersonated the official America250 site and Raffles London at The OWO hotel, relaying content from the real sites in an adversary-in-the-middle attack model.
The researchers also discovered that the threat actor had compromised Ukrainian web analytics service Plerdy and modified its SEO tracker, which was loaded by thousands of websites, mostly in Ukraine, between August 27 and September 3.
In all cases, the initial payload was JavaScript code that profiled website visitors to determine their devices and browser versions. The command-and-control (C2) server then pushed the correct expl…

articles.title: “Signing in to your company’s plugins one by one is annoying”: Anthropic’s fix puts Claude in the identity business
articles.summary:
“Signing in to your company’s plugins one by one is annoying”: Anthropic’s fix puts Claude in the identity business
Anthropic is now letting businesses automatically connect employees to approved Claude plugins, saving staff from having to sign in to and authorize each service individually. The feature also allows Claude to verify users’ organizational membership directly, making it easier for companies to manage access to workplace applications.
The feature builds on the Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA) extension to the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which debuted back in June. As The New Stack reported at the time, this ushered in a way for companies to manage MCP connections centrally through their existing identity providers, with Okta becoming the first to support it.
Anthropic also announced support for the extension in Claude, Claude Code and Cowork on the same day, and published implementation guidance for developers building compatible MCP servers.
In its original guise, the approach relied on the company’s identity provider being compatible with EMA. Okta was the first to support the extension, and adoption among other providers remains limited, meaning many organizations have still had to authorize connections individually.
“Claude itself can issue the signed identity assertions that participating MCP services use to recognize employees.”

articles.title: Peppermint Robotics bags Rs 100 Cr in pre-Series B funding round
articles.summary:
Peppermint Robotics bags Rs 100 Cr in pre-Series B funding round
The startup, which makes autonomous cleaning robots, is backed by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners.
Peppermint Robotics, which makes autonomous cleaning robots, has raised Rs 100 crore (about $10.5 million) in a pre-Series B round led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners. Asiana Fund also participated in the round.
The round involved fresh capital and secondary share transactions.
The money arrives on the back of rapid growth by Peppermint.
The Pune- and Austin-based startup said it doubled its revenue last year and grew nearly sixfold between FY24 and FY26. It last raised Rs 34 crore ($4 million) in a Series A round in April 2025. Peppermint has a presence in nine countries, with the US being its biggest market.
Founded in 2019 at the Society for Innovation and Entrepreneurship at IIT Bombay, the company's autonomous cleaning robots are deployed across a range of commercial and industrial environments, including factories, hospitals, airports, malls, warehouses, hotels and universities. Its machines scrub floors and move materials in factories, hospitals, airports, malls, warehouses, hotels and universities. They are designed to fit into existing routines rather than disrupt workflows.
The company primarily serves facility management companies that oversee cleaning operations, including the selection of equipment, chemicals and cleaning processes.

articles.title: Quantum Roadmaps Are Finally Meeting Reality - EE Times
articles.summary:
Quantum computing passed $1 billion in worldwide revenue in 2025. In the same year, three companies from the first wave of quantum-sector SPACs reported about $138 million against roughly $1.2 billion they had once forecast for 2025.
Those numbers do not cancel each other out. They tell us something more useful. Quantum has reached the point where technical progress, commercial adoption, and market expectations can finally be judged separately.
Five years ago, that was much harder. Companies could show laboratory results and publish ambitious roadmaps, but there was little commercial history against which to test them. Now some of those forecasts have reached their due dates.
Old forecasts can finally be tested
Roughly 12 cents delivered for every forecast dollar is an uncomfortable result. I do not think it proves that quantum computing has failed. It shows that early commercial expectations ran well ahead of what the market delivered.
A missed forecast can come from very different places. Customer adoption may be slower than expected. A hardware milestone may slip. The cost of scaling may rise. An application that looked close to commercial use may turn out to need another generation of systems.
Engineers already think this way. A design target is useful, but the built system is what tells you whether the assumptions held. Quantum companies are increasingly reaching the stage where investors and customers can make the same comparison.

articles.title: Choosing The Right Power Transistor: Why Application Fit Matters More Than Technology
articles.summary:
Silicon MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC MOSFETs, and GaN HEMTs each offer meaningful advantages, but those advantages do not carry the same value across every converter, motor drive, or power stage.
Selecting a power transistor has become less about identifying a universally superior technology and more about matching device behavior to the demands of the application. Silicon MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC MOSFETs, and GaN HEMTs each offer meaningful advantages, but those advantages do not carry the same value across every converter, motor drive, or power stage. The decisive factors are the electrical and thermal realities of the design: bus voltage, current profile, switching frequency, allowable temperature rise, control strategy, commutation behavior, PCB parasitics, and system cost targets.
The discussion begins with the switching and conduction mechanisms that shape the behavior of every power transistor, including crossover loss, inductive switching, parasitic capacitance, reverse conduction and charge-recovery behavior, and the practical distinction between hard-switched and soft-switched operation. These operating modes create different selection priorities: hard-switched stages are often strongly influenced by turn-on loss and commutation behavior, while soft-switched stages depend on the charge to be commutated, the available current, and the ability to maintain soft switching across the operating range. articles.title: Canadian Extradited to US Over Cryptomining Hacks on University Supercomputers
articles.summary:
Two Canadian men face federal prosecution in New York after allegedly orchestrating a multi-year cyber incursion campaign that hijacked computing resources across American universities to secretly mine cryptocurrency.
A federal grand jury indicted Ryan James Roach, 35, of Saskatchewan, and Mathiew James Stubbings, 41, of Ontario, on charges of conspiracy to obtain information and cause damage to protected computers, obtaining information from a protected computer, and intentional computer damage.
Roach was extradited from Canada on October 28, while extradition proceedings against Stubbings remain underway before Canadian courts.
According to the indictment, the intrusions spanned from June 2016 through December 2019, compromising systems at academic institutions in New York, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and Tennessee.
The two allegedly set up multi-country virtual private server infrastructure using fraudulent identities to manage the campaign. “These servers transmitted malware and mining software to victim computers and stored stolen login credentials,” the DOJ explained.
The threat actors specifically singled out campuses maintaining supercomputers, using previously compromised machines as pivot points to conceal their origins.
Canadian court filings revealed that the hijacked university hardware was repurposed to mine a cryptocurrency called Electroneum.

articles.title: Microsoft says Windows is now 20% more responsive and 40% faster at multitasking on 8GB PCs
articles.summary:
What just happened? Microsoft has been promising Windows 11 performance improvement for 8GB PCs for several months. Now, the Redmond giant has dived into the specifics of what that means. It claims the OS is up to 20% more responsive and multitasking is up to 40% faster, but those figures will be best-case scenarios.
Microsoft has spent much of 2026 vowing to improve Windows 11. With the AI-driven memory crisis continuing to make RAM prices akin to that of gold, part of the upgrades has been to make the OS run better on 8GB machines.
Pavan Davuluri, Microsoft's executive vice president of Windows and Devices, writes that the company is taking a 3-pronged approach to this task: making better use of the memory in Windows 11 PCs, protecting the interactions that need to feel instant even under load, and ensuring key apps and Windows require less memory.
Microsoft does acknowledge that Windows 11 PCs with 16GB or 32GB are still going to be better, performance-wise, but it adds that "we're making sure you can do more, even with 8GB."
Those 20% more responsive and 40% faster figures come from Microsoft's own lab tests, so don't expect to see an exact replica of these results.
It was reported last month that Windows can retain up to 2GB more active data in RAM instead of shunting it to slower storage. Tweaked compression should mean fewer reloads when returning to an app or browser tab.
Windows also eases off background tasks such as search indexing to prioritize what you're actuall…

articles.title: Adieu Google à l’école : les établissements qui refusent l’IA perdront le moteur de recherche
articles.summary:
Google va couper son moteur de recherche aux écoles qui refusent son IA, provoquant un scandale aux États-Unis
Google ou l’IA, il faudra choisir. Mardi 3 novembre, le géant a prévenu les écoles américaines : refuser ses outils d’IA en bloc coûtera aussi la recherche Google. Les élèves verront un message d’indisponibilité à la place des résultats, et la règle fait déjà réagir jusqu’à la mairie de New York.
Aux États-Unis, des dizaines de millions d'élèves travaillent sur des Chromebooks, parfois dès la maternelle. Après le déploiement de Gemini dans les établissements scolaires, Google annonce, dans un billet de blog publié le 3 novembre 2026, une révision des contrôles de Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom et Google Search.
Pour les comptes d'élèves, de la maternelle à la terminale, tout sera désactivé par défaut. Les administrateurs pourront rallumer chaque produit séparément, dans les prochains mois.
Un interrupteur sans position intermédiaire
Le piège tient au regroupement. Search figure dans le même lot que les trois outils d'IA, et la recherche classique sans les réponses générées par l'IA dans Google Search disparaît du menu. Chris Phillips, vice-président de Google chargé de l'éducation, l'a expliqué au New York Times.
	
La recherche et l'IA sont profondément intégrées. Les élèves n'auront pas accès à la recherche, et ils verront un message de leur école indiquant qu'elle n'est pas disponible.

articles.title: Noruega se plantea prohibir gafas inteligentes con cámara en parques y colegios
articles.summary:
El Gobierno de Noruega ha anunciado que quiere prohibir el uso de gafas inteligentes en algunos lugares públicos (como parques o colegios) de forma provisional. El motivo es que con ellas pueden hacerse fotografías o grabaciones de vídeo sin que las personas que están frente a la lente sean conscientes de ello. Asimismo, pueden grabarse conversaciones sin que las personas que participan en ellas sean conscientes de ello.
El ministro de Digitalización y Administración Pública, Torgeir Micaelsen ha explicado que esto da tiempo para analizar la tecnología y discutir sobre cómo debe ser la regulación en el largo plazo. El Ejecutivo va a presentar cuanto antes un proyecto de ley en el Parlamento noruego. Es una iniciativa legislativa.
Los lugares que podrían quedar afectados
Entre los lugares que podrían quedar afectados están playas, museos, centros comerciales y eventos públicos (además de parques). Por otro lado, están los lugares con menores de edad (escuelas, guarderías, zonas de juego y clubes juveniles).
Otra de las preocupaciones son las instalaciones sanitarias y deportivas. Esto puede afectar a consultas médicas o piscinas y gimnasios (con vestuarios y duchas). También se plantea su estudio en universidades y otros centros de educación superior.

“Protocolo Haru”. Hace algo menos de un año y medio el Ayuntamiento de Puerto Real (Cádiz) anunció en su web un nuevo servicio a disposición de sus 42.500 vecinos, uno que, presumía el Consistorio, lo convertía en un “pionero” en España. El servicio en cuestión se bautizó como ‘Protocolo Haru’ y básicamente facilita que las mascotas puedan acceder al tanatorio y cementerio para despedirse de sus dueños.
De hecho, ‘Haru’ es el nombre de un gato rescatado por la edil de Bienestar Animal de Puerto Real, Virginia Mera. La fidelidad y comportamiento del minino llevó a la concejala a preguntarse cómo reaccionaría si ella falleciera. articles.title: Pasos para limpiar la papelera de WhatsApp y conseguir que el teléfono funcione más rápido
articles.summary:
WhatsApp acumula archivos de forma constante y, con el tiempo, puede convertirse en una de las aplicaciones que más memoria consume en un celular. Para liberar espacio y mejorar el rendimiento del dispositivo, la aplicación ofrece una función de limpieza de almacenamiento, también conocida como ‘papelera’, a la que se accede desde los ajustes del propio programa.
Cómo vaciar la papelera y liberar memoria en el celular
El procedimiento consiste en ingresar a Ajustes, luego a Almacenamiento y datos y, dentro de ese menú, a Administración de almacenamiento. Allí, hay que bajar hasta el apartado Revisa y elimina elementos. Para borrar un archivo, basta con pulsar Seleccionar, elegir los elementos deseados y tocar el ícono de la papelera.
Vaciar esta sección puede traducirse en una mejora notable en la velocidad del teléfono. Cuando el almacenamiento interno se acerca a su límite, es habitual que ciertas funciones se vuelvan más lentas o que el sistema muestre avisos de falta de espacio.
El rol de la papelera en la gestión del almacenamiento
La papelera de WhatsApp funciona como un paso intermedio entre el contenido que el usuario decide descartar y su eliminación definitiva del teléfono. En la práctica, opera como un depósito temporal de fotos, videos, audios y documentos que ya no se visualizan en los chats o que fueron descartados, pero que de todos modos ocupan espacio en la memoria del dispositivo.

articles.title: 4 heures pour piller Binance : la plateforme crypto révèle ce qu'il s'est vraiment passé lors de la cyberattaque
articles.summary:
Binance est revenu en détail sur la cyberattaque éclair qui l’a délesté de plus de 6 milliards de dollars de cryptomonnaies. Le géant de l’industrie commence par présenter ses excuses à ses utilisateurs « pour l’inquiétude, les perturbations et l’incertitude » découlant du vol, et rappelle que près de 2,85 milliards de dollars de cryptos dérobés ont été gelés ou interceptés. Un faux entretien d’embauche à l’origine de la cyberattaque

Au début de l’été, un ingénieur de l’équipe chargée des portefeuilles chez Binance se met à la recherche d’un outil de codage par IA sur un moteur de recherche. Sans s’en rendre compte, il finit par télécharger une version piégée de Homebrew, un outil très utilisé par les développeurs. L’équipe de sécurité de Binance repère rapidement l’anomalie et remplace l’ordinateur professionnel de l’ingénieur. Malheureusement, le virus, logé dans le code du faux Homebrew, est parvenu à mettre la main sur des informations relatives au travail de l’ingénieur. Was weiß Amazon über Kunden? Ein verstecktes Profil verrät es
In Deutschland ist Amazon aus dem Online-Handel nicht mehr wegzudenken. Einer Studie zufolge kaufen 97 Prozent der Menschen, die im Internet shoppen, wenigstens gelegentlich bei Amazon. Das facht nicht nur den Umsatz an, der Konzern bekommt auch Zugriff auf jede Menge persönliche Daten. Und aus denen lassen sich Vorlieben ableiten, wie eine Threads-Nutzerin mit dem Kontonamen „fangirlinmegan“ festgestellt hat. Sie stieß in der App des Versandhändlers auf ein mehr oder weniger gut verstecktes Menü in den Einkaufseinstellungen. Flaches Gesäß und Kindle-Bücher unter der Dusche

articles.title: OPINION: Ireland is losing Irish companies because they can’t scale here | EU-Startups
articles.summary:
When Ireland’s Government recently announced Budget 2027, it focused on addressing a problem that has beset Ireland’s startup community for decades.
A €1 billion Ireland Strategic Investment Fund (ISIF) scaling programme would seek to provide startups with greater access to growth capital. The need was made particularly stark after, in 2025, the Department of Enterprise grimly projected a €1.1 billion equity-financing gap for Irish enterprises by 2030.
The Budget recognised a problem that startups here have known about for years: Ireland is excellent at getting businesses started, but too many founders struggle to raise the money they need to scale and expand.
Ireland’s scale-up funding gap
This is particularly the case for those seeking Series B investment and beyond. In fact, a 2026 survey from Scale Ireland shows that three-quarters of Irish startup founders find it difficult or very difficult to attract private capital.
Their response tends to be one of two options: sell to a foreign acquirer or move to bigger markets like the UK or US where there is a much larger pool of investors. And why wouldn’t they? It makes sense for the survival and growth of their company.
It does, however, raise a bigger question for Ireland: how do we help more companies grow internationally while keeping their roots here?

Render is taking on Vercel with AI sandboxes that can run indefinitely, along with new tools for managing long-running agent workflows and shared storage.
Announced Wednesday, the launch removes Render’s previous 30-day continuous runtime limit on paid workspace plans. Vercel caps individual sandbox sessions at 24 hours, while Render says its environments can suspend when idle and resume with their files, memory and running processes intact.
Render founder and CEO Anurag Goel, a former Stripe engineer and head of risk, built the platform as an alternative to AWS without the same infrastructure complexity. Now he’s extending that approach to AI agents, combining sandboxes, durable workflows, and shared storage with the applications and databases they depend on.
Not everything is ready yet. Credential brokering will initially be available only to selected customers, private networking for sandboxes is still in development, and Render has yet to settle how its shared storage will handle simultaneous writes to the same file.
Sandboxes that resume mid-task
With this launch, Render sandboxes can stay active through a multi-day codebase migration or while an agent tests an entire application.
The bigger difference comes when a sandbox needs to resume work. Vercel limits uninterrupted sessions to 24 hours, and while persistent sandboxes can restart, their running processes start over.

articles.summary:
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild.
Tracked as CVE-2026-119977, this high-severity WordPress Core flaw stems from a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition and was reported by Picus Security researcher Umut Bayram.
Successful exploitation can let remote threat actors without privileges execute code on the server in high-complexity attacks due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.
"A weakness in the WordPress upgrade process which can lead to remote code execution during the upgrade window," the WordPress security team said on October 28 when it released WordPress 7.1.4 with patches to address this security issue. "Because this is a security release, it is recommended that you update your sites immediately."
CISA confirmed CVE-2026-119977 active exploitation on Tuesday and added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, ordering Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to secure their systems by Friday, as mandated by Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04.
"This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and poses significant risks to the federal enterprise," the cybersecurity agency warned.

Es führt kein Weg am Altern vorbei, aber unsere Körper lassen nicht gleich schnell oder in derselben Form nach. Die einen können mit 60 noch zügig ihre Bahnen im Schwimmbad ziehen, die anderen geraten schon bei kürzeren Spaziergängen außer Atem. Auch unsere kognitiven Fähigkeiten, Organe, Muskelkraft und das Immunsystem können entweder relativ gut in Schuss sein oder stärker abnehmen.
Ob wir also langsamer oder schneller altern als unsere Altersgenossen im Durchschnitt – und damit biologisch jünger oder älter sind als unser in Geburtstagen gemessenes chronologisches Alter –, war bisher eher aufwendig und teuer zu bestimmen. Eine ganze Reihe von sogenannten Alternsuhren misst verschiedene Spuren des Alterns. Dafür sind allerdings DNA-Proben, Blut- und Vitalwerte oder gar Gehirnaufnahmen aus bildgebenden Großgeräten nötig.

Two new Xbox previews will let players try out using a phone as a controller on smart TVs, as well as cloud connect on the Xbox Nano to connect directly to cloud servers.

Xbox Cloud Gaming is getting a phone controller and new direct Wi-Fi connectivity for the Xbox Nano.
“Instead of a Bluetooth connection to your TV, cloud connect uses your Wi-Fi to connect directly to the cloud server running your game,” says the Xbox team. “That can help reduce input latency, so gameplay may feel more responsive.”
Players in the US will be able to preview the new cloud connect option for the Xbox Nano controller starting today. If you’re not in the US you will be able to preview a new phone controller option on smart TVs. The controller is available on the Xbox Cloud Gaming website, allowing people to use the streaming service without a dedicated Bluetooth controller.
Microsoft says “both experiences are still being tested” and that “availability and supported games or devices may be limited” during this beta phase. You’ll need to use the Xbox beta app for Android or the Xbox Accessories app on PC to set up cloud connect on the Nano controller, and the smart TV phone controller just requires a toggle of preview features from the Settings > Account section of Xbox Cloud Gaming.

articles.summary:
Binance diz que hackers prepararam roubo bilionário por meses
Investigação aponta falsas entrevistas de emprego, programas maliciosos e até o uso de ferramenta interna de IA.
A Binance afirma que os responsáveis pelo roubo de US$ 6,34 bilhões (cerca de R$ 34,7 bilhões, em conversão direta) passaram meses preparando a invasão. Segundo uma investigação divulgada pela corretora, a operação começou em junho, com a instalação de um programa malicioso, e avançou em setembro, quando funcionários passaram a ser abordados por falsos recrutadores.
O roubo aconteceu em 29 de outubro e foi considerado o maior da história das criptomoedas. A apuração inicial apontava o computador de um engenheiro como porta de entrada, mas o relatório publicado na terça-feira (03/11) descreve uma operação mais complexa, envolvendo diferentes funcionários e até uma ferramenta interna de inteligência artificial.

articles.title: Hay tantos mapaches sueltos por Alemania que alguien ha tenido una idea radical: empezar a comérselos

Spoiler: no lo era.
Sobre todo, porque no estaban solos. Once años después, 25 mapaches escaparon de una granja peletera en la provincia de Brandeburgo. De esos 29 mapaches descienden los casi dos millones de mapaches que hoy viven en el país. Se han convertido en una auténtica plaga, pero ahora algunos alemanes han tenido una idea: comérselos.
¿Comérselos? Efectivamente. En 2025, Steffen Haaßengier, el cocinero del Zum Lindeneck de Weimar, puso el mapache en carta de forma fija: la hamburguesa a 17,50 euros y la pierna con Klöße a 25-30. Un cazador le entrega hasta 20 animales al mes, ya desollados y con el certificado de triquina.
Puede parecer una excentricidad, pero no lo es. El 18 de abril de 2026 el restaurante celebró el que probablemente fue el primer curso alemán dedicado solo a esta carne: hubo unas 70 solicitudes para 20 plazas.
Suena bien, sí. Pero no hace falta decir que un plato no es un plan de control.
El problema en perspectiva. Por poner todas las cifras encima de la mesa, en el año cinegético que fue de abril de 2024 a marzo de 2025, la Federación Alemana de Caza (DJV) registró 284.220 mapaches muertos, entre capturados y abatidos. Es un récord histórico y, aun así, la población no ha bajado.

articles.title: The App Is Just the Tip: What It Takes to Build Mobile Infrastructure at Scale
articles.summary:
Key Takeaways
- Moving response aggregation, feature-flag evaluation, and error handling off the mobile client into a server-side gateway cut product-detail render time roughly in half and reduced per-screen network calls from five-to-seven down to one.
- A backend-driven UI lets teams change what users see by editing gateway configuration instead of shipping an app release, dropping time from code-complete to majority rollout from one-to-two weeks to under four hours.
- Server-driven UI (SDUI) is not a single decision: full SDUI, hybrid, and data-only each trade adoption cost against product velocity, with a hybrid model fitting an established app with bespoke components.
- Classifying every downstream call per screen as required, preferred, or optional in a dependency-criticality matrix co-owned by engineering and product decides degradation behavior before an incident rather than during one.
- A live, high-traffic system can be migrated without a faithful staging environment by running shadow mode, comparing responses, then graduating traffic through canary stages with automated rollback tied to error-rate thresholds.

articles.title: Cómo tener el mismo número de mi celular si viajo de vacaciones fuera de mi país
articles.summary:
Mantener la conectividad telefónica durante viajes internacionales tradicionalmente implicaba dos opciones restrictivas: asumir las altas tarifas del roaming (itinerancia) de los operadores locales o adquirir un chip físico (SIM) en el país de destino, lo que obligaba al usuario a perder temporalmente su número telefónico original.
En 2026, la consolidación de la tecnología eSIM y las funciones de doble línea en los sistemas operativos móviles permiten conservar el número principal para llamadas y mensajes, utilizando simultáneamente un plan de datos local a bajo costo.
Qué es y cómo funciona la tecnología eSIM
La eSIM (embedded SIM) es un microchip de identidad de abonado integrado directamente en la placa base del teléfono móvil durante su fabricación. A diferencia de las tarjetas plásticas extraíbles, la eSIM no requiere manipulación física.
La activación del servicio se realiza mediante la descarga de un perfil digital, un proceso que requiere únicamente el escaneo de un código QR proporcionado por el proveedor o la introducción de un código alfanumérico en el menú de configuración de redes del dispositivo.
Esta arquitectura permite almacenar múltiples perfiles de operadores en un solo teléfono y alternar entre ellos de forma digital. La eliminación de la bandeja física para tarjetas SIM es un estándar en dispositivos de gama alta actuales, lo que convierte a la eSIM en el método principal de conectividad internacional.

The two vulnerabilities were found and reported by Pentest-Tools security researchers and affect systems running SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier.
The first GMS flaw disclosed this week is tracked as CVE-2026-109593, and it enables unauthenticated attackers with network access to vulnerable instances (running GMS 9.5.2 and earlier versions) to steal sensitive information by reading internal files.
SonicWall also flagged a second security issue (CVE-2026-109594) that can let threat actors with high privileges access or modify information stored in the GMS database through low-complexity SQL Injection attacks.
On Tuesday, SonicWall also urged customers to upgrade to NMS, as it will not release security patches because the vulnerable systems have now reached end of life.
"The affected product has reached End-of-Life (EOL). As a result, no remediation or security update will be released for these vulnerabilities," SonicWall warned on Tuesday.
"Organizations using the product should be aware of the associated security risks and are strongly encouraged to upgrade to the SonicWall Network Security Manager (NSM)."

articles.title: Google Calendar phishing campaign hijacks sessions, bypasses MFA
articles.summary:
Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been harvesting live Google sessions from corporate users. Every signal defenders usually rely on to judge a link returned a reassuring answer, and the operator built the chain that way on purpose.
Material Security’s Threat Research team identified the campaign and has taken down hundreds of domains used by attackers in what they have dubbed Operation CloudFire. Here’s what they learned along the way.
The lure: Google Calendar invites
The messages arrive as Google Calendar invites, sometimes delivered by BCC and often sent from an organization the recipient has already corresponded with. The pretexts are mundane: voicemail notifications, RFP and RFI requests, court summonses, and missed payment notices.
Most links point to Google itself. The typical pattern is Google’s own /url redirector with the real destination in a query parameter, though other waves used share.google and Drive file links for the same purpose. One variant used Intuit transaction notification links.
In every case, when the message is scored, the domain, certificate, and reputation displayed are legitimate and trusted.
The capture: Reverse proxy in front of a Google sign-in page
The attacker runs a live reverse proxy in front of the genuine Google sign-in page. The victim enters a password, receives a real prompt, and approves it, all while the operator watches the session in real time.

A "DNS zone" is the collection of records, settings, and metadata for a given domain like tomshardware.com. The records are the main part, containing IP addresses, hostnames, or text lines including website and mail server IPs, subdomains, domain redirections, and spam-control or certificate info. If you're a Cloudflare customer, when you update a record pointing your website to a new IP, or change one of the domain's settings, the service pushes this information onto its many thousands of DNS servers.
This sounds easy enough until you realize that Cloudflare's DNS fleet is huge, and that the company now gets 800 zone changes per second, up from 250 four years ago. ForgeCode’s Tushar Mathur wants software development to run like a factory, not a project
At TechSparks 2026, ForgeCode Founder and CEO Tushar Mathur demonstrated how AI agents can manage software development from specification to deployment, while engineers focus on supervision and decision-making.
Traditionally, scaling software development meant adding engineers, time, and resources. AI is changing that equation by making code cheaper and faster to write. But generating code faster does not necessarily mean delivering software faster. Code still needs to be reviewed, tested, and deployed, creating new bottlenecks for engineering teams.
For engineering leaders, this raises a question: how can software delivery scale without a corresponding increase in headcount?
ForgeCode is addressing this challenge by building what it calls an AI-native software factory. The platform uses AI agents to manage the software development lifecycle, from specifications and implementation to testing and deployment, with humans providing oversight.
At TechSparks 2026, Founder and CEO Tushar Mathur demonstrated how the platform works and explained why the falling cost of writing code is making review, testing, and deployment more important to software delivery.

Thankfully, the answer to the question about whether the NPU can render the Windows 11 desktop - and apps like Notepad and Edge windows - is a yes. The npu-driver functions as intended and as demonstrated. Moreover, it seamlessly switches back to GPU rendering if/when it needs to.

Y es que la casa que ha comprado, situada en la aldea de Cañada del Real Tesoro, a un paso de la estación de tren de Cortes de la Frontera, tiene los suelos de madera gastados, las paredes pidiendo pintura y un jardín tomado por la maleza, tal y como explica la propietaria en su anuncio de Worldpackers.
Un plan que pide manos. Además del andén, la casa tiene un supermercado y un bar de tapas a mano, y su dueña tiene claro cómo quiere reformarla. Para eso necesita algo más que dinero: gente dispuesta a arremangarse, y de ahí que haya acudido a la popular plataforma donde los viajeros pueden ponerse en contacto con anfitriones que ofrecen techo y comida a quien les ayude.
El trato consiste en dedicar 18 horas semanales a la reforma a cambio de alojamiento y comida, con un calendario concentrado en octubre y noviembre de 2026, la época que la anfitriona considera la más bonita del año en el valle.
De lunes a viernes, los voluntarios trabajan codo con codo con empresas de construcción locales, y la propietaria se acerca a la casa los fines de semana. La reforma es artesanal y avanza sin prisas.

Wang Xiang, concepteur en chef adjoint du programme spatial habité chinois, a résumé la manœuvre : deux lancements, puis un amarrage en orbite lunaire. Des documents de présentation diffusés depuis la conférence vont plus loin et esquissent un enchaînement de vols d’essai qui s’étalerait de début 2027 à 2029.
Trois astronautes, deux fusées et une poignée de main en orbite lunaire
Deux lanceurs lourds Long March-10 décolleront séparément du pas de tir de Wenchang, sur l’île de Hainan. Le premier expédiera vers la Lune l’atterrisseur Lanyue, littéralement « embrasser la Lune », un engin de près de 26 tonnes capable de déposer deux personnes et un rover de 200 kilos. Le second suivra avec le vaisseau Mengzhou et ses trois astronautes. Une fois les deux véhicules amarrés en orbite lunaire, deux membres d’équipage passeront dans Lanyue pour la descente, pendant que le troisième gardera le vaisseau. L’atterrisseur redécollera ensuite de la surface, retrouvera Mengzhou, et tout le monde rentrera sur Terre à bord de ce dernier.

Reviewing something like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026) honestly feels a bit pointless.
It’s a remake that hews so close to the all-time classic upon which it’s based that there’s not all that much to say. Ocarina of Time was a groundbreaking game on the Nintendo 64 in 1998, and it remains an incredible game to this day. And so, a Nintendo Switch 2 remake that basically just gives you that exact same experience again, but with a few extra bells and whistles, more or less sells itself. That will be more than enough for most people.
But I come from the camp of wanting just a bit more from a gaming remake, especially when the source material is still readily available. (In this case, Ocarina of Time already got a big 3DS remaster, while the original version of the game is available on Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 via Nintendo Switch Online.) Indeed, I would have liked to see some creative ambition here. Legendary Zelda producer Eiji Aonuma (who directed the original Ocarina of Time) even recently said he was surprised the remake team didn’t make more changes.
All of that is to say that my thoughts on the remake are pretty minimal. If nothing else, I will give Nintendo credit for the visuals. I was initially put off by the puppet-inspired character models, but I’ve warmed up to them, and on a wider level, the vibrancy and texture that it brings to Hyrule is undeniably impressive. Modelos tradicionais sairiam de linha gradualmente a partir de 2027, dando lugar a versões com tela OLED sensível ao toque.

A possibilidade surge poucos dias após a estreia dos primeiros MacBooks Pro com tela OLED sensível ao toque. Por enquanto, a Apple mantém os notebooks anteriores com painel mini-LED no catálogo como alternativas mais baratas.
A Apple optou por não substituir imediatamente toda a família quando apresentou os primeiros MacBooks Pro com tela sensível ao toque. As versões de 14 e 16 polegadas com telas mini-LED e chips M5 Pro e M5 Max, por exemplo, continuam à venda. Eles saem por a partir de R$ 24.999, R$ 10 mil a menos do que a versão com tela touch.
Segundo Gurman, a separação deve ser temporária. Manter duas linhas de notebooks profissionais aumentaria a complexidade de desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização dos produtos.
A expectativa é que a Apple concentre a linha nos displays touch à medida que a nova tecnologia amadureça. Isso não significa, porém, que os modelos atuais já tenham uma data para sair de linha. De acordo com Gurman, a empresa ainda não definiu quando deixará de atualizá-los.

articles.title: Apple encuentra en los 2 nm una salida a sus problemas de fabricación
articles.summary:
Los SoC más avanzados que podemos encontrar en el interior de algunos dispositivos de Apple, como los iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo o iMac 2026, han sido fabricados por TSMC en su nodo N2 (2 nm). Poco a poco esta tecnología de integración irá llegando a otros productos de la compañía de Cupertino, pero es probable que el despliegue de esta categoría de circuitos integrados sea más lento de lo que le gustaría a Apple.
De hecho, durante el último trimestre fiscal la capacidad de producción de los nodos más avanzados de TSMC ha limitado la disponibilidad de los SoC más sofisticados diseñados por la firma de la manzana. Este escenario representa un problema para Apple, y posiblemente también para otros clientes de este fabricante taiwanés de semiconductores, como Nvidia, AMD o Qualcomm. No obstante, afortunadamente para ellos, el panorama está empezando a mejorar.
TSMC no publica el rendimiento por oblea de sus nodos litográficos, pero esta información suele filtrarse. En marzo de 2025, según las filtraciones, el nodo N2 tenía un rendimiento por oblea de alrededor del 60%, por lo que solo 60 de cada 100 chips producidos funcionaban correctamente. Actualmente, de nuevo según las filtraciones, el rendimiento de este nodo está cerca del 90%. Esta es la evolución habitual de una tecnología litográfica, y para Apple y otros clientes de TSMC ese 90% es una gran noticia.

articles.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France
articles.summary:
France's national blood service has confirmed that a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature and defrost settings at three of its facilities, threatening stored blood products.
The French Blood Establishment (Établissement français du sang or EFS), which manages blood collection, processing, and distribution across France, said the incident occurred on November 2 and affected systems used to monitor and control cold-storage chambers.
According to a statement published on November 3, EFS was not directly targeted in the cyberattack, but was instead its refrigeration supplier.
While EFS has not named the affected supplier, European refrigeration equipment provider Coolworld Rentals confirmed in a statement that a cybersecurity incident involving remote monitoring software had affected a limited number of its refrigeration units.
Coolworld says the attackers exploited a vulnerability in a third-party component, which was outside the company's direct control.
"The vulnerability currently being reported in the media relates to a component from a third-party supplier and was outside Coolworld's direct control," the company said.
"Only a limited number of Coolworld units were affected, and Coolworld responded promptly and took appropriate measures."
The company said it is working with affected customers but will not comment on individual cases.

Stockal investors allege unauthorised sale of US stocks worth millions
Nearly 30 Indian investors allege that their Stockal accounts were accessed without authorisation, leading to the sale of their US blue-chip holdings and purchases of a little-known stock that subsequently plunged nearly 60%.
Nearly 30 Indian investors who trade US shares through Stockal Securities have reported unauthorised access to their accounts, alleging that their blue-chip holdings, worth millions of dollars in total, were sold off without their consent and replaced with shares in a little-known company that subsequently lost almost 60% of its value.
According to the complaints, the proceeds from the forced sales were used to buy shares in Zhibao Technology Inc., which trades under the ticker ZBAO.
One affected investor, a senior official, saw stocks worth $335,768 sold and converted into 300,000 ZBAO shares at $1.05 apiece. The share price subsequently fell to $0.42, putting his losses at around Rs 4.26 crore.
The pattern has alarmed investors, who point out that coordinated buying across multiple accounts could inflate the price of a thinly traded stock, a tactic associated with so-called pump-and-dump schemes. However, the complaints do not establish who, if anyone, profited from the trades.

Long-standing technological debt is being charged with interest.
The phrase "when it rains, it pours" applies both to weather and computer security, as proven the week of October 19, 2026, when OpenAI's GPT 5.6-Sol discovered critical vulnerabilities in the open-source programming language PHP. As published in a post-mortem, a small team of maintainers knew of the issue two years ago. Security experts had warned for decades about mounting technical debt, as agentic AI exponentially sped up vulnerability scanning, to the point that the usual 90-day disclosure window for security exploits became pointless. PHP, one of the internet's ubiquitous software packages, was unlucky enough to in the crosshairs of bug-hunting AI agents.
PHP hosts around 70% of websites on the internet, and the vulnerability allows for remote code execution with enough attacker knowledge. That combination is enough to sound alarms, but the situation got worse once the collective internet realized that, at the time, 73% of PHP installations online were running end-of-life versions with no active support — eliciting face-palms from many techies, and an exasperated sigh from anyone familiar with the ecosystem, myself included. So ultimately the problem wasn't really the vulnerability, but the general complacency.

Rodovias terão cobertura ampliada até para clientes de operadoras que não atendem os trechos. Medida abrange regiões do interior.
A Agência Nacional de Telecomunicações aprovou hoje (04/11), por unanimidade, regras que tornarão obrigatório o roaming para clientes de outras empresas em rodovias estaduais e federais, além de pequenos municípios com menos de 30 mil habitantes e localidades não-sede, mesmo em cidades maiores.
O roaming permite que o celular se conecte à rede de outra operadora quando está fora da área de cobertura da sua prestadora original. Nos pequenos municípios e nas localidades não-sede, como vilas no interior, a obrigação valerá apenas para áreas incluídas em compromissos de cobertura (como os previstos em leilões de espectro), ou que tenham recebido financiamento federal para a instalação da infraestrutura.
Nas rodovias estaduais e federais, a exigência é universal, exceto nos trechos situados em áreas urbanas das sedes de municípios com mais de 30 mil habitantes.
As novas regras também preveem que o atendimento em roaming nestas localidades ocorra automaticamente e seguindo as condições do plano contratado pelo cliente, portanto, sem custo adicional.

articles.title: Pistes cyclables à Paris : voici la liste des rues et carrefours transformés dès 2027

Après la victoire d’Emmanuel Grégoire aux élections municipales 2026 pour la succession d’Anne Hidalgo, Paris reste favorable au développement de la pratique du vélo électrique et mécanique. Le nouveau maire l’a confirmé le mercredi 14 octobre en présentant la troisième phase du plan vélo, qui court de 2027 à 2032.
200 millions d’euros, avec les carrefours dangereux en priorité
La capitale y consacre 200 millions d’euros sur la période 2027-2032, soit moins que les plus de 250 millions d’euros annoncés pour le plan 2021-2026. « La progression du vélo doit conduire à poursuivre les aménagements et à adapter le réseau à sa fréquentation », indique la Ville de Paris, qui veut des « parcours continus, lisibles et sûrs, tout en améliorant les déplacements des piétons et la circulation des bus ».
Elle veut également atteindre son objectif « Vision Zéro », soit « zéro mort et zéro blessé grave sur la route d’ici 2050 ». Nous en sommes encore loin, puisque plusieurs cyclistes ont perdu la vie ces derniers mois, le plus souvent dans des carrefours dangereux.
Le plan prévoit de sécuriser 420 carrefours supplémentaires, dont 56 dès 2027. Depuis 2020, la Ville en a déjà traité 350, dont 87 depuis 2025 (13 rien que durant l’été 2026). articles.title: Revolut va désactiver ses anciens IBAN : attention si vous recevez votre salaire sur la néobanque
articles.summary:
Voilà un message que les clients et clientes de l’application bancaire Revolut auraient tort d’ignorer. Dans un e-mail envoyé ce mercredi 4 novembre, la société prévient que celles et ceux dont le compte est encore lié à l’IBAN lituanien (qui commence par LT) subiront un changement notable à compter du 4 janvier 2027.
Précisément, l’IBAN lituanien sera définitivement désactivé à cette date, ce qui laisse deux mois aux clients concernés pour s’organiser. Ce numéro, propre à chaque client, date de l’époque où la néobanque n’avait pas encore de succursale en France, avant l’arrivée des IBAN français en mai 2022 (ceux commençant par FR76).
La vérification est importante : si un employeur, un organisme qui verse des allocations ou un fournisseur passe encore par ce vieux numéro lituanien, ça va coincer. À partir du 4 janvier, Revolut rejettera les virements entrants et les renverra à l’expéditeur. Il faut dès à présent prévenir les tiers qui utilisent encore ce numéro et leur fournir l’IBAN français.
Cela peut sinon entraîner de vives déconvenues : des salaires qui n’arrivent pas, des prélèvements automatiques qui sont refusés et des paiements qui n’aboutissent pas. Mieux vaut ne pas attendre le dernier moment : la date tombe juste après les fêtes, quand de nombreux services tournent au ralenti.
Pendant ce temps, Revolut devient une vraie banque française
Cette coupure intervient alors que Revolut change de statut en France : le 10 août, la néobanque a décroché un agrément bancair…

articles.title: What AI-ready data demands
articles.summary:
What AI-ready data demands
AI-ready data must be trusted and machine-accessible
AI-ready data must be trusted and machine-accessible. Data products provide the structure AI agents need to reliably discover and use enterprise data.
When an employee looks at a dashboard with conflicting metrics, they can figure out the ambiguity. When an AI agent hits the same wall, it amplifies the error at scale.
Head of AI at The Modern Data Company.
Four requirements separate data that an AI model can trust from data that breaks it. These are not engineering preferences. They are the conditions under which a model can produce outcomes that an organization can stand behind.
AI-ready data needs to be:
Trusted:
Data must be governed, traceable, and auditable end-to-end. Trusted data means more than having a data catalog or a lineage diagram sitting in a wiki. It means that every dataset a model touches carries its provenance with it: where it came from, when it was last validated, who owns it, and what transformations it has passed through.
Rules need to travel with the data, not live separately in downstream tools. When governance is decoupled from the data itself, it breaks silently. A model ingests a redefined field, a changed policy, or a deprecated source and produces a confident, wrong answer.
When a model produces an outcome, the organization must be able to explain it and stand behind it. That is only possible when the chain of custody is intact at the point of inference, not reconstru…

articles.title: The DEA banned a drug some opioid users called a miracle
articles.summary:
In 2012, as the driver of deaths in the opioid crisis began moving from prescription pills to heroin, Laura Bohn was tasked with finding safer drugs to manage pain.
Funded by the National Institute on Drug Abuse, in 2017 she and other scientists revealed in the science journal Cell that several compounds—including a particularly promising one called SR-17018—could relieve pain in mice without causing respiratory depression. That’s a big deal, because respiratory depression is typically what causes people using opioids to stop breathing and die.
Bohn, senior associate vice president of research at University of South Florida Health, says her team filed a patent on SR-17018. They went on to discover that mice using the chemical did not develop a high tolerance for it and that mice already dependent on morphine—a powerful opioid—could consume SR-17018 to reset their tolerance without suffering from painful withdrawal symptoms.
It’s no longer just mice who use SR-17018.
On Reddit and Discord, people who use drugs frequently refer to the compound as a godsend that’s helped them quit using opioids they’re addicted to. Until very recently, the drug, though not regulated by the US Food and Drug Administration, was relatively easy to purchase online, as it was not a federally controlled substance. Bohn, meanwhile, has been in the process of trying to conduct clinical trials on humans, which has never been done.

Le moteur de recherche intégré à la messagerie Outlook se modernise. Microsoft vient en effet d’annoncer plusieurs nouveautés en cours de déploiement dans votre boîte de réception pour améliorer les résultats obtenus lorsque vous cherchez du contenu dans votre courrier. Une modernisation qui s’appuie en partie sur l’intelligence artificielle et qui permet d’accélérer la recherche, mais surtout d’améliorer la pertinence des résultats.
Des résultats plus pertinents en tête de liste
Le premier point d’amélioration sur lequel Microsoft s’est penchée concerne la pertinence des résultats affichés lorsque vous lancez une requête dans le moteur de recherche de la messagerie. articles.summary:
Cabinet approves Rs 2,814 Cr scheme to promote processing of lithium, nickel
The scheme aims to develop domestic processing capabilities in India to support value addition within the country, reduce import dependence, and develop value chain.
The government on Wednesday approved a capex support scheme to promote processing of critical minerals lithium and nickel with a financial outlay of Rs 2,814 crore over a period of five years till 2030-31.
The decision was taken at a Union Cabinet meeting under the chairmanship of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The scheme aims to develop domestic processing capabilities in India to support value addition within the country, reduce import dependence, and develop a value chain.
Under the scheme, capital subsidy of 30% of eligible investment will be provided for setting up four critical mineral processing plants, comprising two lithium processing plants and two nickel processing plants. The maximum capital support will be capped at Rs 500 crore per lithium beneficiary and Rs 900 crore per nickel beneficiary, respectively.
Critical minerals are vital for economic development, national security, and modern clean-energy technologies. They are key components of modern technologies and essential for a low-carbon future. From solar panels and electric vehicles to electronic devices carried in pockets, critical minerals form the foundation of a modern, net-zero economy.

La règle s’applique depuis le 1er novembre, le jour où s’ouvre chaque année la période des jours rouges.
Pour les abonnés, ce sont ainsi deux soirées festives qui ne seront plus facturées au prix fort. Un jour rouge, le kilowattheure monte en effet à 72,95 centimes d’euro en heures pleines, soit près de 4 fois le prix de l’option Base du tarif réglementé, rappelle Que Choisir.
Mais pourquoi viser ces deux dates en particulier ? Le 31 décembre 2025 était un jour rouge pour les abonnés à EDF Tempo, et la nouvelle a logiquement été mal reçue. Dans sa délibération du 21 octobre 2026, la CRE rappelle que la même situation s’était produite le 31 décembre 2014, le premier hiver où RTE, le gestionnaire du réseau de transport d’électricité, choisissait les couleurs. « Une rupture avec la pratique d’EDF, qui était chargé de tirer les jours rouge jusqu’alors, consistant à éviter de placer un jour rouge au réveillon de la Saint Sylvestre », souligne la CRE.
La CRE a mené une consultation publique, du 22 mai au 24 juillet 2026, visant à faire « évoluer la méthode des modalités de tirage de la couleur des jours Tempo ». Americans are saying no to data center developments.
Several counties in the U.S. have put data center concerns on the midterm ballot, and early results show that Americans are overwhelmingly voting against them. According to Data Centers on the Ballot, 33 measures restricting data center development have already won, with six more questions leading. Only one measure in Harwood, North Dakota, which adds an extra review process for industrial projects, including data centers, has failed, while a further five have no posted results. This is a major setback for the Trump administration, which has been pushing for AI development in the U.S., but not a surprising result, as one database has shown that “America hates data centers,” with polls showing that 70% of Americans oppose AI data center build-outs.
Note that the issues put to a vote are varied, ranging from outright permanent data center bans to moratoriums, time-limited actions, limitations based on size or consumption, and more. The mid-term elections also resulted in the recall of the mayor and two council members in Piqua, Ohio, and the mayor of Yukon, Oklahoma, for previously supporting data center bans. The first two, sound and song detection, don’t represent potential privacy concerns; they are designed to detect either important sounds — like an alarm or doorbell — or identify a song using Shazam’s technology.
