The features record and then transcribe or summarize the conversations happening with and around the Apple Watch’s owner. L’Apple TV 4K est un excellent boîtier multimédia, mais il conserve quelques limites frustrantes pour les amateurs de home cinéma. Parmi elles, l’impossibilité de profiter pleinement des pistes audio haute définition des Blu-ray et UHD Blu-ray lorsqu’on lit leurs fichiers vidéo depuis une bibliothèque personnelle.
Des applications populaires comme Plex ou Infuse savent décoder ces pistes, mais perdent les informations spatiales associées aux canaux de hauteur. Avec la version 2.0 de Native Player, disponible depuis le 27 octobre, ce compromis appartient enfin au passé.
Du Dolby Atmos sans perte, mais sans passthrough
Native Player parvenait déjà à préserver les canaux de hauteur, mais au prix d’une compression audio avec perte. Cette nouvelle version restitue désormais le Dolby Atmos en TrueHD sans perte, jusqu’en 9.1.6 canaux. Le DTS:X est également pris en charge, mais toujours restitué en 7.1.4.
Il ne s’agit toutefois pas d’un véritable passthrough audio. L’application décode et effectue elle-même le rendu spatial sur l’Apple TV, puis transmet les canaux audio décodés à l’amplificateur. The development comes after Razorpay submitted its draft IPO papers with Sebi through the confidential route in June, initiating the process to tap the public markets.
Fintech firm Razorpay has secured approval from markets regulator Sebi for its proposed initial public offering (IPO) of Rs 5,000-6,000 crore, sources familiar with the development said on Wednesday.
The company is targeting a valuation of around $5 billion through the public offering, they added.
The development comes after Razorpay submitted its draft IPO papers with Sebi through the confidential route in June, initiating the process to tap the public markets.

La plupart des assureurs les proposent dans les mêmes formules que les thermiques : tiers, intermédiaire et tous risques. Il faut en revanche regarder de près les volets « batterie » et « assistance » : sans la bonne formule, tomber à court d’énergie peut vite coûter cher. La prise en charge d’une panne sèche n’a rien d’automatique
Vous roulez, encore et encore, jusqu’à ce que la batterie de votre voiture vide son dernier kilowattheure. Tout s’éteint et c’est l’immobilisation nette.
Si votre réflexe immédiat est de composer le numéro de votre assistance, la réalité contractuelle peut vite vous refroidir. La prise en charge d’une panne sèche (d’électricité, donc) n’a rien d’automatique dans les contrats standards, et ce, même si vous vous trouvez à plus de 50 kilomètres de votre domicile. À vrai dire, ces fameux 50 kilomètres (plus ou moins selon les compagnies) inclus de base dans les formules ne s’appliquent qu’aux pannes techniques, et non pas à un oubli de recharge ou à une mauvaise estimation d’autonomie.
Sans une clause explicite ou une option dédiée, l’immobilisation de votre véhicule peut rester intégralement à votre charge.

articles.title: Edmontonians have lost $20 million to an international phone scam
articles.summary:
Edmonton Police Service (EPS) is warning residents about an international fraud network that has cost Edmontonians millions of dollars.
In a Tuesday news release, EPS shared details on its investigation into the scam, which it says had been operating since at least October 2024 and was linked to multiple call centres in Lahore, Pakistan. As part of the scam, fraudsters pretended to be representatives of telecoms like Rogers, Telus and Virgin, and offered free or heavily discounted cellphones to persuade victims to provide personal information and order new devices through their legitimate service providers.
Once victims received the phones, they would receive follow-up calls claiming the wrong devices had been shipped and were instructed to ship them to another address. From there, the fraudsters would collect the devices and resell them. EPS says it’s aware of about 100 reports of this scam in Edmonton, which it says has collectively cost residents around $20 million in losses.
EPS says a 31-year-old Edmonton man was arrested in connection with the scam and that it’s shared the results of its investigation with the appropriate international authorities.
Notably, the EPS isn’t the only Canadian law enforcement dealing with these kinds of scams. Earlier this year, we reported on warnings from several Ontario police agencies about telecom scams.

articles.title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Sequoia Capital posted a memo to X on Wednesday morning titled “The Sequoia of Tomorrow” that’s full of surprises. The firm has raised roughly $10 billion in new funds, it says. It is also closing its London office, shutting down its Arc accelerator and its Scouts program, merging its early-stage and growth teams into one, flattening its partnership, and killing the Monday partner meeting.
The framing is forward-looking, but the messaging is very much about rewinding to an earlier time when the team was smaller and focused more narrowly on Silicon Valley.
Sequoia says as much itself. The firm describes coming out of a roughly 20-year expansionary phase during which it built multiple businesses in multiple geographies and says an unintended side effect was hierarchy. Nearly everything being undone here was built during that stretch, under a succession of stewards running from Doug Leone to Jim Goetz to Roelof Botha.
One of the most surprising developments is that the firm is killing two programs that put Sequoia closest to young founders. Scouts, which Sequoia launched around 2009 and, anecdotally, half the industry has since copied in some form, gave small checks to founders and operators to invest on the firm’s behalf; it was a way to see deals through people closer to interesting new founders than any partner could be. The $6.34 billion represents the biggest sum ever targeted in a cryptocurrency theft.
Advanced persistent threat

The film company behind the Elizabeth Holmes documentary “You Can See Everything,” A24, posted on Instagram that it granted a request from NASA to screen the film on the International Space Station (ISS).
Unless A24 is deceiving us (why would they?), it appears that some astronauts can’t wait to come back to Earth to see the film that everyone’s talking about, which has reached number one at the box office.
“You Can See Everything,” directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, initially debuted in North America with a limited theatrical rollout. The film has been so successful, though, that it’s generating demand from international audiences.
Sony Pictures acquired the right to release the film in theaters in Germany, Latin America, South Korea, and other territories, though it hasn’t announced its plans yet. The film won’t come out in the U.K. until November 20, while French viewers will have to wait until December 30.
So yes, it is currently easier to watch “You Can See Everything” in low Earth orbit than in London. These hard-working astronauts can take a break from their complex scientific research to address an equally bewildering question: Does Elizabeth Holmes really believe her own lies?

This year, the World Cup united elite athletes from around the world in competition at the highest level.
As I watched, I kept returning to one question: What makes these athletes elite? Knowledge, fitness, or desire to win don’t fully explain it. It’s something else. It’s mastery of the task. Execution at the highest level when it matters most is what separates the elite from the rest.
President and CEO at NXP Semiconductors.

Excellence is not thinking harder
If you’re a football fan, you’ve seen Messi play. He handles the ball so effortlessly it looks like cheating. The moves he makes seem to anticipate what the opponent will do. Look closer at that idea of “doing without thinking,” and you find it everywhere. Keeping balance, blinking, or navigating a crowded room, all of it with no deliberation and minimal energy. And yet for machines this is the hardest thing of all.

Thermal Grizzly launches PhaseSheet PTM Pro with improved thermal conductivity — new thermal pad promises easier installation and better cooling performance
Easier installation and improved thermal conductivity.
Thermal Grizzly has announced the PhaseSheet PTM Pro, an improved version of its popular phase-changing thermal pad. According to the manufacturer, the new thermal pad offers increased thermal conductivity alongside a redesigned carrier film that makes the PhaseSheet PTM Pro easier to handle and install. While this may seem like a relatively minor change, the new carrier film is designed to peel away more easily from both sides, reducing the risk of tearing the sheet during installation.
Like the original PhaseSheet PTM, the Pro version uses a phase-changing material that alters its physical properties depending on the temperature. At room temperature, the sheet remains solid, much like a conventional thermal pad. However, at temperatures above 45°C, the material transitions into a very low-viscosity liquid that behaves similarly to thermal paste.
This phase-changing behavior helps minimize the pump-out effect commonly associated with traditional thermal paste. Pump-out occurs when thermal paste gradually moves out from between a heatsink and a GPU die or CPU IHS due to repeated thermal expansion and contraction of the contacting surfaces. Over time, this can reduce the amount of thermal paste covering the contact area and potentially degrade cooling performance.

articles.summary:
Valve, empresa estadounidense de videojuegos y tecnología, reconoció que Steam tarda hasta 12 días hábiles en revisar los juegos nuevos que le envían los estudios, el triple de lo habitual. La empresa lo informó el 3 de noviembre y cambió la lista de requisitos para los desarrolladores. Varios estudios independientes ya perdieron su fecha de estreno por la demora.
Valve explicó que recibió “un aumento significativo” de envíos para revisión de tienda y de páginas en los últimos meses. Su objetivo es responder en tres a cinco días. Según la empresa, buena parte del atraso se debe a que debe revisar de nuevo los mismos juegos.
Para reducir esas repeticiones, Valve pidió que cada juego se ejecute al menos cinco minutos a través de Steam antes de enviarlo. “Aunque no lo crean, a veces revisamos versiones que nunca se jugaron a través de la tienda”, escribió la compañía.
La lista incluye otros controles. Los estudios deben confirmar los componentes que el juego necesita instalar y comprobar que los logros funcionen y que las partidas guardadas en la nube estén bien configuradas. También deben etiquetar las capturas de pantalla y subir al menos cinco de juego real, sin frases publicitarias. Valve agregó que prepara más mejoras para la revisión de versiones y que estos cambios son “un buen punto de partida”.

articles.title: Windows 95 au poignet : cette montre remplace les aiguilles par des curseurs de souris
articles.summary:
Un fond turquoise, des fenêtres grises et une barre de chargement : la Desktop 95 transforme les souvenirs de vieux PC Microsoft en montre analogique. Jusqu’aux aiguilles, remplacées par deux pointeurs de souris.
Il fut un temps où l’on cliquait sur « Démarrer » pour éteindre son ordinateur. Où « trois minutes restantes » pouvait laisser le temps d’aller goûter et de revenir. La marque hongkongaise Benly propose d’emporter un morceau de cette époque au poignet, avec la Desktop 95. Sur son cadran, le programme est déjà lancé : « Loading memories… ».
Les curseurs donnent l’heure, les souvenirs chargent
La version bleue retrouve le turquoise caractéristique des bureaux Windows de l’époque, avec ses fenêtres aux bordures en relief, ses petites icônes et sa barre des tâches. On aurait presque envie de chercher le Démineur pour occuper quelques minutes.
Au centre, une main et une flèche de souris font office d’aiguilles. Elles parcourent ce décor informatique en pointant vers les repères horaires disposés sur le pourtour. Une seconde version adopte un fond clair et réorganise les éléments, pour ceux qui ont suffisamment vu de turquoise dans leur jeunesse.
Le détail le plus amusant reste cette boîte de dialogue « Loading memories… », accompagnée d’une barre de progression. Celle-ci n’avancera jamais, mais inutile de chercher Ctrl + Alt + Suppr ou de cliquer frénétiquement, ça ne fera pas arriver la suite plus vite.
Pour ceux qui préfèrent retrouver une interface rétro sur leur écran…

articles.title: Waymo confirms it's shaking up its Uber relationship in January 2028 | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Waymo will end its exclusivity with Uber in the Austin and Atlanta markets starting in January 2028, co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana told Bloomberg News in a report published Wednesday.
The robotaxi company will offer rides directly through its own smartphone app, like it does in other cities. Uber confirmed to TechCrunch Wednesday that it still plans to host Waymo robotaxis on its app for as long as the two companies agree. Waymo did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Mawakana’s comments come after reporting earlier this year by the Financial Times that Waymo was looking to get out of its deal with Uber, which was set to expire in May 2028. Mawakana told Bloomberg that Waymo initially partnered with Uber because the ride-hail giant offered scale. But the experience for riders has been “a little bit of a crapshoot,” she said, especially because riders never know for sure if they’re going to hail a robotaxi or a human-driven car.
“It’s important for us to have that relationship with the rider. We’ve gotten that feedback from the riders in those markets,” Mawakana said.
Uber — which has many robotaxi and other autonomous vehicle partners — told Bloomberg that it was Waymo’s idea not to add an option in the ride-hail giant’s app to book a robotaxi directly.
This story has been updated with new information from Uber.

I’ve watched a lot of technology waves roll through the enterprise. And in my experience, the ones that catch organizations flat-footed are never the ones nobody saw coming. They’re the ones everyone saw coming and still didn’t prepare for.
Agentic AI is shaping up to be one of those waves.
Chief Product and Technology Officer at Apica.
The conversation in enterprise IT right now is almost entirely focused on the models, which one to choose, how to govern its outputs, whether the ROI is real.
What’s not getting nearly enough attention is what happens to your IT infrastructure when those agents start running. Specifically, what happens to your telemetry data.
Recent Omdia research surveying more than 300 enterprise IT decision-makers across North America and Western Europe should make any CTO uncomfortable.
The explosion is already happening and most organizations are already behind

articles.title: Los glaciares de los Pirineos tienen fecha de caducidad: apuntan a desaparecer por completo en 2034
articles.summary:
Los glaciares que hay en los Pirineos están viviendo sus horas más bajas. Lo que durante siglos fue un paisaje dominado por masas de hielo perpetuo se está transformando a un ritmo que ya no se mide en siglos, sino en veranos de mucha calor. Así lo apuntan los últimos datos de la campaña 2025-2026, que confirman que estamos asistiendo a la extinción en tiempo real de los últimos glaciares de la península ibérica, un proceso irreversible que podrá culminar en 2034.
Un respiro. Podría parecer que 2026 dio un respiro a las cumbres, puesto que durante la primavera, el Pirineo registró nevadas abundantes que dejaron valores récord a principios de marzo. Sin embargo, el informe publicado a finales de octubre por CryoPyr ha apuntado a que la nieve invernal ya no es un escudo frente a los tórridos veranos que estamos viviendo.
Y no es para menos, puesto que esta temporada se ha cerrado como el tercer año con más pérdidas de hielo desde que comenzaron los registros anuales en el año 2012, solo superado por las campañas 2021-2022 y 2022-2023.
La medida. Para medir este declive, los investigadores han abandonado las viejas estimaciones y ahora utilizan drones que generan modelos 3D de alta resolución. Al superponer estos modelos con los de años anteriores, se ha podido ver que en Ossoue (la vertiente francesa) la pérdida media fue de 3,1 metros de espesor, con zonas que han llegado a perder 4,9 metros.

articles.title: En pleine nuit, des voleurs s'emparent d'une remorque de batteries Stellantis estimée à 500 000 €
articles.summary:
Stellantis victime d’un vol de batteries d'une valeur de 500 000 €, une remorque entière a été dérobée en pleine nuit
Une remorque remplie de cellules de batteries, estimée à 500 000 €, a été volée près de l’usine Stellantis de Hordain (Nord). De quoi donner des sueurs froides à toute la chaîne logistique du géant automobile.
Les composants de voitures électrifiées séduisent les voleurs, et Stellantis vient d’en faire les frais avec une pleine remorque de cellules de batteries subtilisée. Destinées aux véhicules hybrides et électriques du groupe, elles ont tout simplement été dérobées à deux pas de son usine nordiste de Hordain. D’après une source proche du dossier, le butin atteindrait un demi-million d’euros. Cependant, sa revente s’avère bien plus compliquée que prévu.
Un vol de batteries évalué à 500 000 € : la piste du grand banditisme privilégiée
Les faits remontent à une quinzaine de jours, près de Valenciennes. En pleine nuit, des malfaiteurs ont déjoué les dispositifs de sécurité pour repartir avec un poids lourd stationné chez GSF, un prestataire logistique situé juste en face du site industriel de Hordain. Contacté par l’AFP, Stellantis a confirmé ce vol chez son sous-traitant, qui a déposé plainte auprès de la gendarmerie dans la foulée. Selon La Voix du Nord, l’enquête a été confiée à la police judiciaire de Lille, qui privilégie la piste du grand banditisme et une équipe particulièrement bien renseignée.

The Canadian Charging Infrastructure Council (CCIC) surveyed nine organizations, including seven charge point operators or charging networks and two engineering, procurement, and construction contractors.

articles.title: Nova tecnologia deixa o Bluetooth 4 vezes mais rápido • Tecnoblog
articles.summary:
Nova tecnologia deixa o Bluetooth 4 vezes mais rápido
Padrão HDT permite que conexões Bluetooth LE alcance até 7,5 Mb/s, sendo útil para fones de ouvido avançados, por exemplo.
Esta quarta-feira (04/11) foi a data escolhida pelo Bluetooth SIG para anunciar o Bluetooth High Data Throughput (HDT), um novo recurso da especificação Bluetooth Core 7.0 que aumenta a velocidade da conexão, sendo interessante para transmissões de áudio em fones de ouvido, por exemplo.
O HDT é opcional e direcionado a transmissões de dados feitas via Bluetooth LE (Bluetooth Low Energy), que são relativamente comuns em fones de ouvido, relógios inteligentes, kits de teclado e mouse, entre outros dispositivos portáteis.
Atualmente, o Bluetooth LE permite transmissões com taxa de até 2 Mb/s (megabits por segundo). Já o Bluetooth LE com HDT pode alcançar 7,5 Mb/s, uma taxa máxima de transmissão quase quatro vezes superior.
Como já sinalizado, conexões Bluetooth LE são relativamente comuns em dispositivos de som. Nesse sentido, o padrão HDT poderá facilitar a transmissão sem fio de áudio de alta resolução, de áudio espacial, de som surround com múltiplos canais, e assim por diante.
É verdade que, especificamente para aplicações sonoras, já contamos com o Bluetooth LE Audio. Mas o HDT não vem para substituir essa especificação, mas ampliar as capacidades do Bluetooth LE de modo geral, permitindo que a largura de banda ampliada seja usada em dispositivos de áudio mais sofisticados, por exemplo.

However new analysis has found that workers who regularly use AI are actually working longer days than those who don't.
In fact, the study from ActivTrak discovered that AI users are often working up to 90 minutes longer every day.
AI boom or bust?

'Heavy' AI users, aka those which used AI tools for more than 45 minutes across at least five sessions a day, also spent an additional 18 minutes working after hours compared with non-users.

Parmi tous les retours et tests de l’appareil, un point précis est parfois revenu : l’écran externe de l’iPhone Duo est difficilement utilisable à une main, étant donné son format plutôt large. L’air de rien, il peut s’agir d’un souci relativement contraignant dans la vie de tous les jours. Mais bonne nouvelle, Apple a maintenant une solution pour les personnes qui ont relevé ce petit désagrément.

Parmi les nouveautés, nous pouvons noter l’intégration de la fonctionnalité « Accès facile » (Reachability) à destination de l’iPhone Duo. Pour rappel, la fonction « Accès facile » sur iPhone permet à l’utilisateur de faire descendre le contenu de l’écran vers le bas afin de pouvoir contrôler le téléphone avec un seul doigt. L’écran glisse donc verticalement. Sur l’iPhone Duo, la fonctionnalité « Accès facile » fonctionne différemment en faisant glisser l’écran vers la droite ou la gauche, c’est-à-dire horizontalement. Ainsi, l’utilisateur peut manipuler l’écran externe du téléphone à une main. Il suffit de décaler horizontalement l’écran à droite ou à gauche, à sa convenance.

The death of physical games could be getting closer as Macronix, one of Nintendo’s key ROM chip suppliers for Switch and Switch 2 game cartridges, is reportedly shutting down its ROM business to focus on manufacturing NOR and NAND flash chips to supply data centers, multiple reports claim. There will be no new ROM products, and Q3 is the last quarter it reports ROM sales separately.

Entre el público general, el clima sigue en el primer lugar en todos los grupos etarios. La IA, en cambio, subió del séptimo al segundo puesto. Los expertos ubican detrás de la IA y el clima los riesgos geopolíticos, los cibernéticos y los energéticos.

The Agentic Data Cloud was launched earlier this year at Google Cloud Next. It’s meant to be the architectural “system of action” for AI agents, replacing the brittle extract, transform and load-based data pipelines, or ETL, that feed legacy software applications. The key advantage of Agentic Data Cloud is that it meets customers where their data is, so rather than forcing them to squeeze all of their information in a large, centralized data warehouse, it enables AI agents to access it wherever it lives.
In a blog post, Sirish Chandrasekaran, Google’s vice president of product management for data analytics, outlined the company’s belief that autonomous agents rather than humans will soon become the primary consumers of data. articles.title: CISA Confirms Hackers Exploiting WordPress Core Flaw During Software Upgrades
articles.summary:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a security flaw in WordPress Core to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.
The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS score: 8.1), is a case of Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition that could be exploited to achieve arbitrary code execution on affected servers. Patches for the flaw were released late last month.
"WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window," CISA said. "This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades."
Details of the flaw emerged last week when Wordfence said exploiting the vulnerability does not require an account on the site. That said, it does require an attacker to exploit a brief window during a complete Core update that could allow unauthenticated code execution.
During the first 21 hours after public disclosure, the WordPress security company said it recorded more than 18,500 requests targeting staged "setup-config.php" installer paths. As of writing, 12,632 attacks attempting to exploit the flaw have been blocked in the last 24 hours.

The release goes after a problem that tends to surface once agents leave the demo stage. A failing agent might have a bad prompt, a broken tool or a weak underlying model.
Oumi says enterprises have traditionally tried to fix it with prompt and harness engineering because retraining a model’s weights has required skills normally found at frontier AI labs. That approach often stalls before the agent is reliable enough to put to work.
Oumi’s Frontier AI Engineer already sets objectives, designs evaluations and runs training experiments for custom models on its platform. With today’s update, a team can describe in plain language what it wants an agent to accomplish, and FAiE helps define the tools and environments that agent needs before moving on to evaluation and training. Co-founder and Chief Executive Manos Koukoumidis said better prompts and bigger generic models will only take agents so far. articles.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
articles.summary:
A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.
The flaw, CVE-2026-58868, affects Android 14 through 17. Phones get the fix with security patch level 2026-11-01 or later, which phone makers and carriers send on their own schedules.
As of November 4, Google's bulletin did not report any attacks exploiting its flaws. None of them was in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, kept by the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, as of its November 3 update.
The flaw is a possible out-of-bounds write caused by a heap buffer overflow in the onOutputReceived function of the file FrameDecoder.cpp. Neither the bulletin nor the flaw's CVE record says how an attacker would reach that code.
Google's Critical rating assumes that the protections built into Android and Google's services are turned off or bypassed.
Older versions, such as Android 12 and 13, are not listed as affected by the flaw. Google's records do not say whether they contain it.
How to Check Your Phone
Google's help page gives these steps:
- Open the Settings app.
- Tap About phone, or About tablet, then Android version.
- Find the dates for the Android security update and the Google Play system update.
The Android security update date is the phone's security patch level. A date of 2026-11-01 or later covers CVE-2026-58868 and the other flaws in the Framework, System, and Android runtime components.

Wednesday, November 4th 2026
Steam Wants Devs to Play Their Games For At Least 5 Minutes First
Valve now requires developers to launch their game through the Steam client and run it for at least five minutes before submitting it for review, as part of several new additions to Steam's pre-release checklist. It doesn't have to be the developer playing, since anyone's playtime counts, as long as it was logged within the past seven days, or since the last build upload if that's older. Apparently, Valve keeps getting builds that were never run through Steam at all, which is how games end up with broken launch options or missing depots. 
The changes are meant to cut down Steam's review backlog. Valve says store page and build submissions have jumped over the last few months, and it's quite obvious why that would be. For Valve, build reviews that usually take three to five days are now taking up to 12 business days, largely because games that fail basic checks have to be reviewed again. Other new checks include at least five screenshots tagged as gameplay, a test save written to Steam Cloud for games that support it, a list of required redistributables like DirectX or Visual C++, and complete achievement setup.Valve doesn't say what is driving the surge, but it's easy enough to make the connection. Descope launches Envoy to let consumer apps accept personal AI agents as users
Customer and agentic identity platform company Descope Inc. today launched Envoy, a service that lets consumer websites and apps accept personal artificial intelligence agents acting for their customers without rebuilding how people sign in.
Agents arriving through Envoy get an identity of their own, separate from the customer’s. The launch goes after a choice consumer businesses have been stuck with since agents such as Meta Platforms Inc.’s Muse started shopping and paying for things on people’s behalf.
Amazon.com Inc. blocked Muse from its store in September, saying the agent did not identify itself as one when placing orders, and JPMorgan Chase & Co. moved a month later to keep outside agents away from customer bank accounts. Descope expects blocking will get harder to maintain as more customers do their shopping through an agent.
The alternative, in Descope’s telling, is an agent that signs in as the customer with the person’s own password and one-time code. Nothing in that session shows software was involved, so when a fraud rule fires the logs point at the person. The business ends up absorbing the cost in disputed orders and returns.

articles.title: Hay físicos empeñados en demostrar que Einstein se equivocó y los neutrinos del Mediterráneo, de momento, no les dan la razón
articles.summary:
La ciencia lleva muchos años estudiando la teoría de la relatividad de Einstein y analizando si todos los pilares sobre los que se sostiene son suficientemente sólidos. De vez en cuando, alguno se tambalea, mientras que otros cobran aún más fuerza con cada nuevo descubrimiento. Uno de los que están todavía en duda es la invarianza de Lorentz, un principio que, a grandes rasgos, dice que las leyes de la física son las mismas en cualquier dirección del universo. Hay científicos que consideran que este principio podría romperse a escalas extremas. De ser así, Einstein estaría equivocado. No hay nada que le apetezca más a algunos investigadores que quitarle un poco de razón al genio, de ahí que quieran demostrarlo.
Muchas técnicas se postulan como útiles para lograrlo, pero sin duda las que se basan en la detección de neutrinos son de las más estudiadas. Por eso, un equipo de científicos ha estado realizando experimentos con ellos en las profundidades del mar Mediterráneo.

Intel's upcoming Core Ultra 4000 "Nova Lake-S" desktop processors will reportedly cap their maximum core frequency at 5.1 GHz whenever they run above 90°C, according to Intel leaker Jaykihn on X. He says the limit applies to the entire Nova Lake-S desktop lineup, works separately from regular TjMax throttling at 100°C, and can't be raised. He also notes that the information is still preliminary. In practice, it looks like a safety net that sits between normal boost behavior and full thermal throttling. Below 90°C, the chips should presumably boost as usual, and models that don't exceed 5.1 GHz in the first place wouldn't be affected at all. 
Final Nova Lake clocks aren't official yet, though the current Core Ultra 9 285K already boosts up to 5.7 GHz, so a high-end Nova Lake chip that runs hot could lose a sizable chunk of its peak frequency. A 100°C TjMax would also be lower than Arrow Lake's 105°C, which can be manually raised to 115°C on the 285K. That puts more weight on cooling, since the 28-core Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC was reportedly set to pull up to 296 W at PL2 despite its 125 W rating, and staying under 90°C at that kind of power draw will probably take a really capable cooler. Nova Lake-S is currently expected to arrive in Q1 2027, and Intel hasn't confirmed any of this yet.

articles.title: Radio With No Radar: Why Agent Runtime Security Fails Without the Layers Beneath It
articles.summary:
Nearly every agent security pitch now ends on the same promise: the product stops the bad action in real time. The promise holds for one kind of agent, the kind whose traffic passes through a gateway the enterprise owns. Most agents never touch one.
One recent case shows what that gap looks like in practice. An employee asked an AI assistant to trigger a mass-email automation. The automation hit a recipient-limit policy and failed, so the assistant, which was also connected to the employee's personal mailbox, offered to send the batch from there instead. The employee approved without registering that the assistant was about to route around the sanctioned system. An unknown number of external recipients received email from a personal account rather than the approved channel.
No jailbreak was involved. The assistant did exactly what it was built to do, and the fix was not retraining a model. It was a single runtime rule that blocks any attempt to reach more than fifty external domains and explains to the user what the tool is about to do. Knowing where to apply a rule like that depends on seeing which agents exist, what they are connected to and what normal looks like for each. That visibility is the part most runtime pitches skip.
The runtime is the application, not the pipe

articles.title: Xen Hypervisor Flaws Let One Malicious VM Read and Write Any Other VM's Memory
articles.summary:
Two flaws in the Xen hypervisor allow a malicious guest virtual machine (VM) to read and write the memory of other VMs on the same host, including dom0.
Dom0 is the VM that, by default, has full permissions and manages the others. Patches are out, and there is no known mitigation, the Xen Project said in an advisory on November 3.
All Xen versions from 4.6 onward are vulnerable, while 4.5 and earlier are not. The flaws are tracked as CVE-2026-102703 and CVE-2026-102704, under Xen advisory XSA-523.
The Xen Project credited AI company Anthropic with finding the flaws using its Claude model. Stephan Lipp of Ada Logics then validated the finding, and the CodeAnt AI Security Research Team later independently reported the same issue.
The flaws are in grant copy, the operation Xen uses to copy data between VMs. Each VM tells Xen which of its memory pages other VMs may use, and Xen checks those permissions.
To save time on a batch of copies within the same memory page, Xen reuses checks it has already made. In some cases, it did not check again when it should have. That mistake is what lets a malicious guest read and write memory it does not own.
XCP-ng, an open-source virtualization platform built around Xen, said in its update notes that "a single compromised guest can break out of its isolation and take over the whole host."
Xen's advisory does not mention any attacks that exploit the flaws or specify what access within the VM an attacker needs.

articles.title: Critical Rails Flaw Lets Attackers Write Server Files via Crafted ImageMagick Uploads
articles.summary:
A critical flaw in Ruby on Rails could allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on an app's server by uploading a crafted file if the app processes uploads using ImageMagick. The Rails project disclosed the flaw in an advisory and fixed it in versions 8.1.4.1 and 8.0.5.2.
The flaw is in Active Storage, the part of Rails that handles file uploads. Some apps store uploaded files using Active Storage's Disk service, which stores them on the server's disk. In those apps, an attacker could also read any file the app can read.
Those files typically include the app's secret_key_base and its credentials for other systems, according to Rails. Reading them may in turn allow remote code execution or lateral movement into those systems.
Rails rates the flaw 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS scale. It is tracked as GHSA-f3w6-w445-fwh9 and does not yet have a CVE identifier.
ImageMagick selects a format handler, which it calls a coder, based on the file's content. Some coders act on other files named inside the image, not on the image itself. Active Storage imposes no limits on which coders an upload can use, so the server's own ImageMagick policy was the only limit.
The ImageMagick analyzer in Active Storage runs when a file is attached. Attaching the upload is enough to reach the flaw. The app does not have to make a variant (a transformed copy of the image) or a preview, or call analyze.

Las elecciones de medio término en Estados Unidos dejaron en claro, según analistas e inversores, que el rechazo a los centros de datos de inteligencia artificial se convirtió en una fuerza electoral con consecuencias directas para una industria que mueve billones de dólares.

articles.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an OpenAI Codex jailbreak bundle that's designed to modify an artificial intelligence (AI) agent's trusted instructions to insert advertisements for a third-party AI gateway.
The phenomenon has been codenamed prompt adware by Check Point Research.
Called Haiou (meaning Seagull in Chinese), the jailbreak modifies OpenAI Codex's configuration files to inject advertisements for the jailbreak author's website into subsequent agent responses.
"The advertised service is an opaque, OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway, a middleware between an application and an LLM provider," Check Point Research said in a technical report. "The likely business model is to use the freely distributed jailbreak bundle as an acquisition channel for the paid gateway service."
Adware is a type of software that displays unwanted advertisements, which can appear on users' computers or mobile devices, often in the form of pop-ups or banners. Prompt adware extends this sketchy behavior to AI agents by means of a jailbreak that defeats the model's safety training and content guardrails.
The idea is to persistently modify the agent's global instructions through natural language to influence future responses. This, in turn, causes common greetings or activation words like "Seagull," "hi," "hello," "hey," "yo," and "are you there?" to trigger an advertisement for "zz.aiapi2025[.]top."

articles.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root
articles.summary:
A flaw in APT, the package manager for Debian and Ubuntu, allows an attacker who can modify package downloads to swap a checked package for their own.
The attacker's code then runs as root, according to advisories that Debian, Ubuntu, and APT's developers published on November 4. The attack needs APT to retry failed downloads, which it does by default from Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04 onward.
Debian has released fixed versions of APT for the flaw, CVE-2026-109518. APT's developers, who call the flaw critical, say updates for Ubuntu and its Ubuntu Pro subscription service are being released. Ubuntu 14.04 users with Ubuntu Pro can already get one.
Older releases, such as Debian 11 and Ubuntu 20.04, are not exposed by default, according to Ubuntu. But many user scripts may have turned on the retry setting, Acquire::Retries, on those releases anyway, APT's developers say.
Debian's testing branch was still on the vulnerable version 3.3.5 at 14:58 UTC on November 4. For Debian 11, whose Debian long-term support ended on August 31, APT's developers have published a fixed version, 2.2.5.
Ubuntu rates the flaw as high priority, with a CVSS 4.0 score of 7.7, and says that distributions built on Debian and Ubuntu are affected as well, without naming any.
Ubuntu published new APT builds for four of its releases to its security archive at 14:25 UTC on November 4:

articles.title: Dans les écoles, refuser l'IA de Google coupe l'accès au moteur de recherche
articles.summary:
Aux États-Unis, Google laisse désormais les écoles décider si leurs élèves utilisent son intelligence artificielle (IA), mais à un prix : celles qui la refusent perdent aussi Google Search. Une décision qui fait évidemment polémique.
En août, Google a activé par défaut son assistant Gemini dans Classroom, la plateforme que de nombreux enseignants américains utilisent pour distribuer les devoirs à leurs élèves. Une décision contestée par plusieurs responsables d’établissements.
Et depuis, la défiance n’a cessé de grandir : New York et Los Angeles, les deux plus grands districts scolaires du pays, ont limité l’IA sur les appareils des élèves, tandis que des sénateurs ont demandé des comptes à la firme de Mountain View. Elle a donc décidé de réagir.
Pas d’IA, pas de recherche
Sa nouvelle approche touche les élèves de la maternelle au lycée : à partir de 2027, Gemini (son assistant d’IA), Gemini Notebook, Gemini dans Classroom et Google Search seront désactivés par défaut sur leurs comptes scolaires. Seuls les administrateurs de l’établissement pourront les réactiver.
Mais il y a un hic : la recherche, essentielle, figure dans cette liste, et il est impossible de la garder sans l’IA. « Search et l’IA sont profondément intégrés », a expliqué Chris Phillips, vice-président de Google pour l’éducation, au New York Times. Une école qui refuse l’IA verra donc ses élèves perdre l’accès au moteur de recherche. À la place, un message indiquera que le service n’est pas disponible.
En cause…

La compañía concentró el trabajo en tres áreas: optimizar la memoria en todos los dispositivos con Windows 11, preservar la respuesta de interacciones que deben ser inmediatas aun cuando el sistema está exigido y reducir la memoria requerida por funciones y aplicaciones clave.
Pavan Davuluri, vicepresidente ejecutivo de Windows + Devices de Microsoft, explicó que la meta es que las tareas habituales mantengan una respuesta rápida y estable.
“Una gran experiencia de Windows empieza con una expectativa simple: tu PC debería responder cuando lo necesitas. Abres Inicio. Lanzas una aplicación. Vuelves al documento o pestaña del navegador donde lo dejaste hace una hora y retomas el trabajo. Esos momentos diarios deberían sentirse rápidos y fiables”, señaló Davuluri.

C’est désormais acté : l’ISS sera désorbitée au début des années 30. Si les Américains travaillent sur des stations privées, le Vieux Continent, lui, doit réfléchir à la manière dont il devra s’adapter à cette nouvelle réalité.

Un rendez-vous crucial

articles.title: Why coding agents aren’t delivering the promised gains for engineering – yet
articles.summary:
Why coding agents aren’t delivering the promised gains for engineering – yet
AI writes code in minutes, but engineers are struggling to understand and fix it
Vibe coding agents enable engineers to create code in a fraction of the time. This has shifted the bottleneck to later in the development process: when engineers have to understand what that code is doing, track down bugs, and investigate incidents.
As agents generate ever greater volumes of code, it’s becoming increasingly difficult for engineers to understand their output.
Greg is the co-founder and CTO of Undo.
It takes time to work out what their code does and how it interacts with the systems around it.
To realize the productivity gains, AI must be applied to the later stages of the cycle, not simply code generation. When it comes to large-scale complex code bases, agents struggle.
A critical issue in critical industries
Nowhere is the pain of code comprehension and debugging more acute than in organizations powering the digital economy – from financial services and semiconductor design to the networks and databases that keep everything connected.
In these sectors, one escaped defect can have serious consequences – a trading system returning a bad value, a database returning the wrong row, or a network failure leading to a service blackout. The UK’s national air traffic controller found itself an unfortunate case in point when it revealed that its recent service outage, which caused 2,000 flight cancellations and da…

articles.title: “J'ai tout perdu” : il perd des centaines d'heures de travail suite à la réparation de son PC chez Boulanger
articles.summary:
Un écrivain emmène son PC à réparer chez Boulanger et perd son roman
Comme souvent, c'est une affaire assez courante qui vient aujourd'hui rappeler l'importance de sauvegarder son travail important à plusieurs endroits : un homme a perdu des centaines d'heures d'écriture suite au formatage imprévu de son PC par le SAV de Boulanger.
Gilles n'est pas ravi. Tout a commencé par une panne de son ordinateur portable, et plus spécifiquement de l'un des deux ventilateurs. Il va alors solliciter le SAV de l'enseigne Boulanger, hors garantie. Pour l'écrivain, selon ce qui est écrit sur le contrat initial, seule la pièce en question devait être changer. Cependant, au moment de retrouver son ordinateur, il va se rendre compte que celui-ci a été formaté durant la réparation, et que tout son contenu avait donc été effacé. Y compris le roman sur lequel il travaillait, détruisant ainsi "plusieurs centaines d'heures de travail d'écriture".
Un formatage qui coûte cher
Au-delà de cette perte qu'il vit comme un "choc indescriptible extrêmement violent", l'homme pointe également du doigt qu'il a été facturé plusieurs fois par erreur pour l'opération, et qu'un deuxième contrat a été réalisé "en coulisse" par Boulanger. Pour ces manœuvres et le non-avertissement de formatage de son PC, Gilles souhaite le remboursement du SAV, signalant également que le remontage du PC laisse à désirer.

articles.summary:
Une gigantesque structure se cache dans un système stellaire voisin, et elle est noire comme l’encre
Repérée par James Webb en 2024, une étrange traînée de poussière s'échappe du disque de Bêta Pictoris, à 63 années-lumière de nous. Hubble vient enfin de la saisir en lumière visible. Sa composition raconte une collision titanesque entre deux mondes du calibre de Pluton.
En janvier 2024, le télescope spatial James Webb révélait autour de Bêta Pictoris une excroissance de poussière recourbée, vite surnommée "queue de chat".
Une équipe menée par Arin Avsar, doctorant au Lunar and Planetary Laboratory de l'Université de l'Arizona, l'a traquée dans six campagnes d'observation de Hubble menées entre 2012 et 2025, une nouvelle preuve de la complémentarité de Hubble et James-Webb. Ses conclusions sont parues en octobre dans The Astrophysical Journal Letters.
Âgé d'environ 23 millions d'années, ce système juvénile offre un aperçu de ce qu'a pu être notre Système solaire dans sa prime jeunesse. Il compte trois planètes géantes et un disque de débris que nous voyons par la tranche.
Une poussière de carbone noire comme l'encre
Si la structure a longtemps échappé aux instruments qui observent en lumière visible, c'est à cause de sa matière. Selon les modèles de l'équipe, elle se compose presque exclusivement de matière organique réfractaire : de longues chaînes d'atomes de carbone qui absorbent la lumière et lui donnent une teinte d'un noir profond. Honor expérimenterait des batteries de smartphone d'une capacité comprise entre 14 000 et 15 000 mAh. L'objectif serait de proposer, sur de futurs appareils, une autonomie d'environ une semaine avec une seule charge. Ces informations proviennent du leaker Digital Chat Station, qui les a publiées sur Weibo. Ce leaker de source généralement fiable, indique que le constructeur chercherait à proposer un smartphone capable de tenir jusqu'à sept jours, sans passer par la case recharge. Cependant, charger son smartphone tous les jours est-il vraiment un problème ?

El directivo respondió en X después de que Windows Central publicara una nota sobre una herramienta de terceros creada para reubicar este elemento de la interfaz. Baca sostuvo que la telemetría de Microsoft detectó que buena parte de los usuarios desplazaba la barra de tareas sin intención, simplemente al hacer clic cerca de un borde equivocado.

La barra de tareas de Windows 11 no se puede arrastrar porque Microsoft decidió evitar movimientos accidentales detectados en Windows 10. La compañía reemplazó ese gesto por un ajuste específico dentro de Configuración, accesible con un clic derecho, que permite elegir la posición sin riesgo de desplazamientos involuntarios.

Pour comprendre ce grand chambardement, faisons un petit bond dans le passé, jusque dans les années 1960. Les heures creuses naissent alors avec les premières centrales nucléaires, pour lisser la consommation en poussant les foyers à consommer quand la demande est faible. Soixante ans plus tard, le décor a changé, vous l'aurez sans doute remarqué. L'été, les panneaux solaires gonflent la production en plein après-midi. Dans son tarif de réseau baptisé TURPE 7, la Commission de régulation de l'énergie (CRE) a donc acté le rapprochement des heures bon marché et de ces pics de production. "The Act has put children’s online safety firmly on the agenda, which matters. But Ofcom’s own report this month found no significant overall change in the share of children encountering harmful content, so there’s more work to do," he explained.

- The UK overtook France as Europe's most breached country, while Ukraine jumped from 47th to 6th globally.
- The US still accounts for almost a third of all leaks, and experts say limiting what you share is your best defense.
More than 121.8 million online accounts were compromised around the world between July and September 2026, according to new research from Surfshark. That's a 13.2% rise on the previous quarter.
The UK saw the most dramatic shift. Its leaked account count more than doubled to 5.8 million, a 121.6% jump that pushed it past France to become Europe's most breached country.
Ukraine also surged up the rankings, climbing from 47th place to 6th globally after 2.6 million accounts were breached in just three months.
Most breaches happen on a company's servers rather than your own device, so even the best VPN can't stop your details from leaking. There are still steps you can take to limit the damage, though.
Europe is under growing pressure

WhatsApp avanza en el despliegue de la función para programar el envío de mensajes sin recurrir a aplicaciones externas. La herramienta permite redactar un texto en cualquier momento del día y definir con precisión la fecha y la hora en que llegará al destinatario.
El sistema ya se encuentra activo para un grupo limitado de participantes de los programas beta de Android e iOS, y su llegada se produce de forma progresiva, a medida que Meta la habilita desde sus propios servidores.
Qué es y cómo funciona la programación de mensajes
La función permite fijar un envío con una anticipación mínima de 10 minutos y máxima de 14 días. Dentro de ese margen, el usuario puede modificar el contenido o cancelar la operación antes de que se concrete la entrega.
A diferencia de lo que ocurre con un mensaje convencional, la programación se procesa a través de los servidores en la nube de Meta. Por eso, el envío no depende de que el teléfono esté encendido o conectado a internet: el mensaje llega en el horario fijado aunque el dispositivo se quede sin batería, pierda señal o permanezca apagado.
Los mensajes programados conservan el cifrado de extremo a extremo que ya tiene cualquier comunicación en la aplicación, lo que garantiza que solo los participantes del chat puedan leerlos.
La herramienta no se limita al texto. También admite enlaces, fotografías y videos, tanto en conversaciones individuales como en grupales, aunque cada mensaje programado solo puede incluir un archivo multimedia a la v…

articles.title: Bluetooth aprobó una función que casi cuadruplica su velocidad y traerá audio sin pérdida en 2027
articles.summary:
El Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG), la entidad que fija el estándar de conexión inalámbrica Bluetooth, adoptó el 4 de noviembre una función llamada High Data Throughput (alto flujo de datos) que eleva la velocidad máxima de 2 a 7,5 megabits por segundo, casi cuatro veces más, y permitirá audio sin pérdida de calidad a partir de 2027.
La función es opcional dentro de Bluetooth Core 7.0, la versión vigente del estándar, y opera sobre Bluetooth LE, la variante de bajo consumo que usan auriculares, relojes y sensores. Introduce una nueva capa física: la forma en que la radio codifica los datos para enviarlos por el aire.
El documento técnico del Core 7.0 detalla cinco modos de velocidad: 2, 3, 4, 6 y 7,5 megabits por segundo. Los tres primeros son obligatorios para cualquier dispositivo que adopte la función. Los dos más rápidos son opcionales, y el de 7,5 exige que el equipo también admita el de 6.
Según el SIG, mover más datos en menos tiempo permite que la radio pase más tiempo en reposo, lo que reduce el consumo de energía. La entidad también afirma que la nueva capa mejora la estabilidad de la conexión en entornos exigentes.
El audio sin pérdida será la primera aplicación
El SIG prevé como primer uso un estándar de audio inalámbrico de alta calidad: sonido sin pérdida y de alta resolución, audio envolvente multicanal y espacial, situado para 2027.

Ajustar la iluminación, la imagen y el sonido de un televisor puede transformar una sala común en un espacio con sensación de sala de cine, sin necesidad de obras ni grandes inversiones.
Existen cinco ajustes que inciden de forma directa en la calidad de la experiencia audiovisual en casa: la luz ambiente, la configuración de imagen, el sonido, las características técnicas de la pantalla y la distribución del espacio.
Ajustes para hacer que el TV de una experiencia de cine

La iluminación influye en la comodidad visual al mirar una película. Una luz intensa o dirigida hacia el televisor genera reflejos que dificultan distinguir los detalles de las escenas.
Se recomienda reducir la intensidad de las luces principales y sumar una lámpara lateral o iluminación ambiental tenue, en lugar de dejar la habitación completamente a oscuras.

Cyberattaque de l’EFS, pourquoi le danger est venu d’un prestataire

“La demanda de memoria NOR para centros de datos es muy sólida. Los clientes nos piden más capacidad”, dijo Wu. El ejecutivo aclaró que el cambio “no se debe a una desaceleración de la demanda de NOR”, sino a que la compañía asigna capacidad a la memoria NAND, un segmento que, según dijo, crece con rapidez.

Autant dire qu'elle n'est pas à l'abri de tentative d'espionnage, comme on a pu le voir il y a quelques semaines avec un ingénieur de nationalité saoudienne, arrêté après avoir placé un enregistreur audio dans une pièce souvent utilisée par la direction d'OpenAI. D'après ces témoignages, il y aurait des inquiétudes au sein des employés sur les pratiques de sécurité de la firme IA depuis même avant le lancement de ChatGPT, en novembre 2022. Ces salariés se seraient ouverts à la direction sur cette question, et d'après les retours obtenus, celle-ci semblait beaucoup plus obsédée par le fait de suivre le rythme de la concurrence que d'améliorer la sécurité.

Los robots autónomos que entregan comida a domicilio en Estados Unidos están en el centro de una controversia por la privacidad de los usuarios. Dos compañías dedicadas a este servicio, Coco Robotics y Serve Robotics, enfrentan demandas colectivas por presuntamente recopilar información biométrica de las personas que reciben sus pedidos sin solicitarles autorización.
Las denuncias fueron presentadas el pasado 9 de octubre en el condado de Cook, en Chicago, y apuntan a una posible infracción de la Ley de Privacidad de Información Biométrica de Illinois. Según los demandantes, los dispositivos no solo utilizan sus cámaras y sensores para desplazarse por las calles y evitar obstáculos, sino que también podrían registrar características físicas de quienes se acercan a recoger la comida.
El caso abre un nuevo debate sobre el uso de cámaras, sensores e inteligencia artificial en los servicios de reparto. Aunque estos robots necesitan analizar su entorno para circular de manera autónoma, las demandas cuestionan qué información recopilan durante las entregas, cómo la almacenan y si puede utilizarse posteriormente para otros fines.
Las acusaciones todavía no han sido demostradas ante la justicia y ambas compañías rechazan haber cometido irregularidades.
